task_name: Treating satellite cells with muscle extracts
description: Satellite cells associated with myofibers were treated with tibialis anterior muscle extracts to examine the effect on satellite cell activation.
goal: to examine the effect of extracts on satellite cell activation
span_chunk: To examine the effect of extracts on satellite cell activation, we treated the satellite cells associated with myofibers with tibialis anterior (TA) muscle extracts.

description: Intact myofibers were co-cultured with mechanically damaged myofibers to evaluate satellite cell activation and proliferation.
goal: to evaluate satellite cell activation using isolated healthy intact and damaged individual myofibers
span_chunk: This co-culture of intact myofibers with damaged myofibers allowed us to examine whether DMDFs directly stimulate the activation and proliferation of satellite cells associated with the healthy intact myofibers.

description: Healthy intact myofibers freshly isolated from extensor digitorum longus muscles were mechanically damaged with a Pasteur pipette.
goal: to obtain mechanically damaged myofibers
span_chunk: To obtain mechanically damaged myofibers, healthy intact myofibers freshly isolated from extensor digitorum longus (EDL) muscles were mechanically damaged with a Pasteur pipette in a culture dish.

description: Immunofluorescence studies were conducted to determine the proportions of satellite cells expressing specific markers after treatment with muscle extracts.
span_chunk: The immunofluorescence studies revealed that the proportions of PAX7 + MYOD + , PAX7 + Ki67 + , and PAX7 + EdU + satellite cells increase after adding muscle extracts for 24 h in the floating culture condition compared with the control myofibers maintained in Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium (DMEM) alone.

task_name: Washing out damaged myofibers and media
description: After co-culturing intact myofibers with damaged myofibers, the damaged myofibers and the culture media containing DMDFs were washed out and replaced with fresh DMEM.
goal: to test whether activated satellite cells in the G1 phase return to a quiescent state
span_chunk: The damaged myofibers and the culture media containing DMDFs were then washed out and replaced with fresh DMEM and cultured for an additional 24 h.

description: Proteome analysis was performed with biological replicates to identify damaged myofiber-derived factors (DMDFs) that stimulate activation of satellite cells.
goal: to identify DMDFs that stimulate activation of satellite cells
span_chunk: To identify DMDFs that stimulate activation of satellite cells, proteome analysis was performed with biological replicates.

description: Isolated myofibers associated with satellite cells were treated with recombinant proteins of metabolic enzymes to investigate their role in satellite cell activation.
goal: to investigate if extracellular metabolic enzymes act as moonlighting proteins that stimulate satellite cell activation
span_chunk: To test this likelihood, isolated myofibers associated with satellite cells were treated with recombinant proteins of AK-1, CK, GAPDH, PGAM-2, and TPI in a floating culture condition for 72 h and immunostained for MYOD and PAX7.

task_name: Pre-treatment with DMDFs and growth-factor-rich medium exposure
description: Satellite cells associated with myofibers were pre-exposed to recombinant enzyme proteins and then stimulated with growth-factor-rich medium to promote mitosis and myogenic progression.
goal: to investigate whether metabolic enzymes promote mitosis and myogenic progression under growth-factor-rich conditions
span_chunk: Satellite cells associated with myofibers were pre-exposed to the recombinant enzyme proteins for 48 h under floating culture conditions and then stimulated with growth-factor-rich medium (GM) for a further 24 h.

task_name: In vivo administration of GAPDH recombinant protein
description: GAPDH recombinant protein was administered into TA muscles prior to injection of BaCl2 to induce muscle regeneration and examine the effect on satellite cell activation and proliferation.
goal: to examine whether DMDFs accelerate satellite cell activation and population expansion in vivo
span_chunk: The recombinant protein was administered into TA muscles at 24 h prior to injection of BaCl2 to induce muscle regeneration.

span_chunk: 40 μg of protein was loaded onto 8.5% ( w/v ) SDS-PAGE gels and electrophoretically transferred to nitrocellulose membrane... Membranes were blocked with Western Ezier Blocking buffer and then probed with primary antibody...

span_chunk: MTT assays were performed to determine an appropriate, sublethal, concentration of H2O2 to stress the co-cultures.

description: Hematology and blood biochemistry of COVID-19 patients were retrospectively analyzed using the last available blood sample taken within 24 hours preceding the patient's death.
span_chunk: Hematology and blood biochemistry of COVID-19 patients were retrospectively analyzed. We used the last available blood sample taken in the 24 h preceding the patient’s death.

description: Lung samples were formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded, and serial tissue sections of 4 µm were cut for histological and immunofluorescence examination.

description: Entire lung sections were scanned to screen for areas rich in structures double positive for Cit-H3 and MPO, identified as NET-infiltrating areas.
goal: To assess for the presence of NETs in entire lung sections
span_chunk: To assess for the presence of NETs in entire lung sections, sections were entirely scanned using the Nanozoomer 2.0-HT system... Sections were manually screened for the presence of areas rich in structures staining double positive for Cit-H3 and MPO, which were identified as NET-infiltrating areas as marked in Fig. 2 C.

description: Data were analyzed for statistical significance using a nonparametric Mann–Whitney U test on mean values.
span_chunk: Data in Fig. 1 I are presented as mean and individual values and were analyzed for statistical significance using a nonparametric Mann–Whitney U test on mean values, as indicated in the figure legend.

span_chunk: From each transformation ten colonies were randomly selected and analyzed by PCR to identify those carrying the 30 bp deletion and to establish the 'success rate' of mutagenesis.

task_name: Creating multi-gene mutants by stepwise approach

goal: to generate multi-gene mutants in a stepwise manner
span_chunk: In order to generate multi-gene mutants in a stepwise modality, the pCRISPR-gDNA plasmid used to knockout a given gene has to be removed to allow the next round of transformation with a pCRISPR-gDNA plasmid targeting another gene locus.

description: Creating pCRISPR plasmids carrying two gDNAs for simultaneous mutations at two separated genome loci and co-transforming with two mutagenic oligonucleotides.
goal: to simultaneously create mutations at two genome loci
span_chunk: Finally, we tested the possibility of exploiting the CRISPR/Cas technology to simultaneously create mutations at two separated genome loci.

description: Maintain DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cell lines as previously described.
span_chunk: DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) were maintained as described previously.

description: Subject Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cells to the iChIP procedure and DT40 cells to the in vitro enChIP procedure as previously described, using CRISPR RNA targeting the Pax5 promoter.
span_chunk: Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) (2 × 10 7 each) were subjected to the iChIP procedure as described previously. DT40 was subjected to the in vitro enChIP procedure as described previously.

description: Fragment chromatin DNA, isolate the target region, purify DNA, and prepare DNA libraries using TruSeq ChIP Sample Prep Kit, concentrating fragments around 0.4 kbp in length.

After purification of DNA, DNA libraries were prepared using TruSeq ChIP Sample Prep Kit (Illumina); in this preparation step, DNA fragments around 0.4 kbp in length were selectively concentrated.

description: Subject the DNA libraries to sequencing using the HiSeq platform and perform NGS and data analysis as previously described, mapping data onto the reference genome and detecting narrow peaks using MACS2 and IGV.
span_chunk: The libraries were subjected to DNA sequencing using the HiSeq platform according to the manufacturer’s protocol. NGS and data analysis were performed as described previously.

description: Clone double-stranded DNA encoding target sequences downstream of the U6 promoter in the sgRNA expression plasmid or synthesize and clone DNA fragments coding the U6 promoter, target sequence, gRNA scaffold, and termination signal in plasmids.
span_chunk: For construction of the sgRNA expression plasmids, double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) encoding the target sequences were cloned downstream of the U6 promoter in the sgRNA expression plasmid. Alternatively, DNA fragments coding the U6 promoter, target sequence, gRNA scaffold, and termination signal were synthesized and cloned in plasmids by GeneArt gene synthesis services (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

description: Transfect DT40 cells with Cas9 and sgRNA expression plasmids and a GFP marker by electroporation, sort GFP-positive cells, and expand them individually.
span_chunk: DT40 cells (1 × 10 7 ) were transfected with a Cas9 expression plasmid (120 µg), sgRNA expression plasmids (120 µg) targeting each end of a target genomic region, and pEGFP-N3 (0.3 µg, Clontech) by electroporation using Gene Pulser II (Bio-Rad) at 250 V and 950 µF.

description: Extract genomic DNA from cells, perform genotyping PCR to confirm targeted locus deletion, and follow specified PCR cycles.

description: Extract total RNA from cells and perform quantitative RT-PCR as previously described.
span_chunk: Extraction of total RNA and quantitative RT-PCR were performed as described previously.

description: Perform ChIP assays with DT40 cells and specific antibodies, purify DNA, and use it as a template for real-time PCR.
span_chunk: ChIP assays were performed with DT40 cells (2 × 10 6 ) and each antibody (3.5 µl for H3K4me1 or 2 µg for the others) as described previously.

span_chunk: Worms were grown and maintained on nematode growth media (NGM) plates seeded with Escherichia coli (OP50) and raised at 20°C.

description: Enriched A-CD8+ T cells were stimulated with B-APCs in the presence of IL-2, IL-7, and IL-15 in 24-well plates for 9 days to expand CD8+ CD28- T cells.
goal: to expand CD8+ CD28- T cells
span_chunk: Enriched A-CD8+ T cells (2 × 10 6 cells) were stimulated with B-APCs (1 × 10 6 cells) in 24-well plates in the presence of IL-2(20 U/ml), IL-7 (50 ng/ml) and IL-15 (50 ng/ml). After 9 days’ incubation, in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells were enriched.

task_name: Enrichment of in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells
description: After 9 days of incubation, the in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells were enriched for further experiments.
goal: to enrich in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells
span_chunk: After 9 days’ incubation, in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells were enriched.

task_name: CFSE labeling of A-CD4+ T cells
description: A-CD4+ T cells were labeled with CFSE to track their proliferation when cocultured with APCs and in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells.
goal: to track the proliferation of A-CD4+ T cells
span_chunk: Then, CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells (CD4+ T cells from individual A) (5 × 10 4 /well) were cocultured with B-APCs (5 × 10 4 /well) or I-APCs (5 × 10 4 /well) in the presence or absence of in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells (2. 5 × 10 4 /well) in 96-well round bottom plate for 7 days and 11 days.

task_name: Coculture of T cells and APCs
description: CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells were cocultured with either B-APCs or I-APCs in the presence or absence of in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells in a 96-well plate for 7 and 11 days.
goal: to assess the suppressive activity of CD8+ CD28- T cells
span_chunk: CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells (5 × 10 4 /well) were cocultured with B-APCs (5 × 10 4 /well) or I-APCs (5 × 10 4 /well) in the presence or absence of in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells (2. 5 × 10 4 /well) in 96-well round bottom plate for 7 days and 11 days.

task_name: CFSE dilution assay to assess T cell proliferation
description: The proliferation of CD4+ T cells was assessed using a CFSE dilution assay after coculture with APCs and CD8+ CD28- T cells.
goal: to assess the proliferation of CD4+ T cells
span_chunk: CFSE diluted assay was used to assess the proliferation of CD4+ T cells.

description: Culturing various cell lines (293T, 293L, iSLK.219, TRExBCBL1-RTA, BCBL-1) in specific media supplemented with different compounds and antibiotics, and maintaining them at 37°C in a humidified environment with 5% CO2.
span_chunk: Cell culture 293T and 293L (ATCC, Manassas, VA) cells were grown in high-glucose Dulbecco's modified Eagle's medium (DMEM) supplemented with 8% bovine growth serum (HyClone, Logan, UT), 2 mM l-glutamine, 25 U/ml penicillin, and 25 μg/ml streptomycin. Additionally, 293Ls harboring any of the following: BAC16WT, BAC16 ORF59-Flag, BAC16RTASTOP (generous gift from Dr. Jae Jung), BAC36WT, BAC36Δ50, or BAC36ΔORF59, were cultured in above DMEM supplemented with 50μg/mL hygromycin B. iSLK.219 (generous gift from Dr. Don Ganem), iSLKTet-RTABAC16WT, and iSLKTet-RTABAC16RTASTOP cells (generous gift from Dr. Jae Jung) were maintained in DMEM supplemented with 10% Tet-Free Fetal Bovine Serum with additional 600μg/mL hygromycin B, 400μg/mL G418, 1μg/mL puromycin. iSLK.219 cells with recombinant KSHV BACs were induced by doxycycline. TRExBCBL1-RTA (generous gift from Dr. Jae Jung) and BCBL-1 (ATCC, Manassas, VA), and cells were grown in Roswell Park Memorial Institute medium (RPMI) supplemented with 8% fetal bovine serum (HyClone, Logan, UT), 2 mM l-glutamine, 25 U/ml penicillin, and 25 μg/ml streptomycin. BCBL-1 transduced with shRNA PRMT5 lentiviral vectors (GE Dharmacon, Lafayette, CO) were selected and maintained on 1μg/mL puromycin. BACmid-containing 293L cells were transduced with indicated lentiviral vectors and maintained on 1μg/mL puromycin. All cultures were incubated at 37°C in a humidified environment supplemented with 5% CO2.

description: Generating lentiviral vectors by introducing genes into respective vectors and transfecting them into 293T cells along with packaging vectors for producing virions.
span_chunk: pLVX-ORF59-Flag or pLVXdsRed-ORF59-Flag lentiviral vectors were generated by introducing the gene into respective vectors, and transfecting into 293T cells along with the packaging vectors (CMV-dR8.2, pCMV-VSVG) (Addgene, Cambridge, MA) for producing virions.

task_name: Transduction and selection of target cells
description: Transducing target cells with collected viruses followed by selection with puromycin to obtain a pure population of cells.
span_chunk: Collected viruses were added to the target cells for transduction followed by selection with puromycin (2 mg/ml) to obtain a pure population of cells.

description: Transfecting 293L cells with BAC16 ORF59-Flag using Metafectene Pro followed by selection with hygromycin.
span_chunk: BAC16 ORF59-Flag was transfected into 293L cells with Metafectene Pro (Biontex Laboratories GmbH, San Diego, CA) as previously described [ 50 ] followed by selection with hygromycin to obtain cells maintaining the KSHV BACs.

description: Generating and sub-cloning various plasmids by PCR amplification and cloning, and confirming the integrity of clones by sequencing.
span_chunk: The following plasmids were generated by PCR amplification and cloning: pLVXORF59-Flag, pLVXdsRedORF59-Flag, pA3M-PRMT5-Myc, pA3F-PRMT5-Flag, pxiORF59-HA, pA3M-COPR5-Myc, pA3F-COPR5-Flag, pLVX-RTA, pGex-ORF59-GST. The following plasmids were then sub-cloned: pA3F-PRMT51-210aa-Flag, pA3F-PRMT5210-420aa-Flag, pA3F-PRMT5420-637aa-Flag, pA3F-COPR51-140aa-Flag, pA3fCOPR5141-184aa-Flag, pGex-ORF591-132aa-GST, pGex-ORF59133-264aa-GST, pGex-ORF59265-396aa-GST. PRMT5, COPR5 and their truncations were generated by PCR amplification using specific primers listed in Table C in S1 Text and cloning into respective vectors. The integrity of clones was confirmed by sequencing at Nevada, Genomics Center, Reno.

description: Inserting an epitope tag at the C-terminus of ORF59 by homologous recombination and confirming correct colonies by southern blot analysis, PCR, and sequence analysis.
span_chunk: To generate a recombinant KSHV BAC16 with ORF59-Flag tagged, the epitope tag was inserted at the C-terminus of ORF59 by homologous recombination using a two-step 'seam-less' gal K positive/counter selection scheme. [...] Correct colonies were screened and subjected to confirmation by southern blot analysis, PCR amplification of the junctions and sequence analysis.

description: Transfecting 293T cells with expression vectors, harvesting cells, lysing, immunoprecipitating, and performing Western blotting to detect proteins.
span_chunk: For overexpression experiments, 293T cells were plated to 70–80% confluency followed by transfecting them with expression vectors by combining PEI, transfection reagent and 150mM NaCl, mixing thoroughly and incubating it for 15 minutes at room temperature. [...] The membranes were incubated with appropriate antibodies followed by detection with infrared-dyes tagged secondary antibodies and imaged on an Odyssey imager (LICOR Inc., Lincoln, NE).

description: Cross-linking cells, lysing to collect nuclei, sonication of chromatin, immunoprecipitation with antibodies, and purifying DNA for qPCR amplification.
span_chunk: Chromatin immunoprecipitation was performed as described previously [ 16 ]. Briefly, approximately 20 million cells were cross-linked with 1% formaldehyde for 10 min at room temperature, followed by addition of 125 mM glycine to stop the cross-linking reaction. [...] Purified DNA was used as a template for qPCR amplification of indicated regions of KSHV genome using primers listed in Table B in S1 Text.

description: Performing LowCell ChIP using a kit, fixing cells, shearing chromatin, and precipitating with specific antibodies.
span_chunk: We performed LowCell ChIP using the LowCell ChIP Kit (Diagenode Inc.). Briefly, 1 million cells were fixed as described above followed by a PBS wash and re-suspending them in the kit-provided chromatin-shearing buffer. [...] ChIP-seq and data analysis TRExBCBL1-RTA cells were used for ChIP-seq assay by precipitating the chromatin from both un-induced and doxycycline induced (12h or 24h) cells with indicated antibodies.

description: Performing ChIP-seq assay, preparing DNA sequencing libraries, sequencing on Illumina NextSeq500, and analyzing sequences using CLC Workbench.
span_chunk: DNA extracted from the chromatin bound to respective targets and their appropriate controls was used for preparing the DNA sequencing libraries using NEXTflex TM Illumina ChIP-Seq Library Preparation Kit (Bioo Scientific Inc. TX, USA). [...] Mapped reads were analyzed for enriched peaks in ChIP samples, represented as peak score, with respect to input reads using the 'ChIP-seq' tool of the CLC Workbench 10.0.1 with the minimum peak-calling P-value set to 0.05 [ 53 ].

description: Transfecting cells with siRNA or shRNA vectors, selecting with puromycin, and assessing knockdown efficiency by Western blotting and qPCR.
span_chunk: SmartPool siRNA for control or PRMT5 (Dharmacon, GE Life Sciences) was transfected into iSLK.219 cells using RNAiMax transfection procedure (Lipofectamine, Thermofisher Inc.). [...] Transduced cells were selected with 1μg/mL puromycin and the knockdown efficiencies of both methods were tested with Western blotting and comparative qPCR.

description: Transfecting cells with plasmids or lentiviral vectors, harvesting cells, isolating RNA, generating cDNA, and performing real-time qPCR analysis.
span_chunk: KSHV transcriptome analysis 293L with BAC36WT, BAC36Δ50, BAC36Δ59, BAC16WT, or BAC16RTASTOP were transiently transfected with pLVXdsRedORF59-Flag, pLVX-RTA, or pLVXdsRed, vector control using PEI transfection reagent and cells were harvested 36 hours post transfection. [...] Fold changes were calculated using ΔΔCt method and the error bars represent standard deviation of three experiment replicates.

description: siRNA SMARTpools were dispensed into 384-well plates, sealed, and stored at -80°C.
span_chunk: siRNA SMARTpools (4 siRNAs per gene) at 0.3 µM were dispensed in 10 µl volumes using a Rapidplate384 liquid handler (Qiagen) into triplicate black 384-well plates (Corning), sealed with adhesive seals (ThermoFisher) and plastic lids. Plates were stored at -80°C until needed (minimum 24 h, maximum 48 h).

description: On the day of transfection, plates were thawed, transfection reagent added, and Hela cells were dispensed into each well.
span_chunk: On the day of transfection, assay plates were thawed at room temperature and 10 µl transfection reagent (Dharmafect 1, Dharmacon), diluted in Hank's buffered saline solution (HBSS, ThermoFisher) to give a final concentration of 0.1%, was added using a Multidrop 384 (ThermoFisher). Cells were counted and 3×10 3 cells in 40 µl were added to each well using the Multidrop 384.

description: After transfection, plates were incubated for 48 hours at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.
span_chunk: Plates were incubated for 48 h at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.

description: Media was removed from plates, and cells were infected with virus or media control, followed by incubation.
span_chunk: To infect, media was removed from plates by inversion, and 10 µl media (as for transfection, but containing penicillin-streptomycin; Lonza) or virus (HSV-1-eGFP strain C12, diluted to MOI 0.5 in infection media) [34] was added using the Multidrop 384. Plates were incubated at 37°C for 1 h before 50 µl infection media was added and plates returned to the incubator.

description: Virus replication was monitored by measuring eGFP fluorescence and calculating replication slopes.
span_chunk: Replication was monitored as a function of eGFP fluorescence from 24 h to 80 h post-infection using the POLARstar OPTIMA plate reader (BMG Labtech). Virus replication slopes over the linear phase were calculated and normalized to mock transfected wells on individual assay plates.

description: CellTiter Blue reagent was added to transfected cells to determine cytotoxicity based on fluorescence signal.
goal: to determine the cytotoxicity of siRNAs
span_chunk: Cells were transfected as described above, and the cytotoxicity of siRNAs was determined using the CellTiter Blue (CTB, Promega) reagent, which gives a fluorescent or absorbance signal relative to the number of live cells.

description: The HSV-1 clone collection was cloned into bait vector and screened against a library in prey vector using a semi-automated Y2H assay.
span_chunk: The HSV-1 clone collection was cloned by recombinatorial (GATEWAY™, Invitrogen) and conventional cloning into the bait vector pGBKT7, and screened against a library pooled from 12,381 MGC clones [35] in the pGADT7 prey vector using a semi-automated Y2H assay [77].

description: Interactions between HSV-1 and human proteins were analyzed and connected to a network of human protein-protein interactions.
span_chunk: Interactions between HSV-1 and human proteins were connected to a network of human protein-protein interactions (a total of 62,310) taken from the databases HPRD [78] (Release 9), BioGRID [79], DIP [80], MINT [30] and IntAct (downloaded May 18th 2010).

description: The primary screen phenotype was validated by deconvoluting the assay SMARTpools and testing individual siRNAs.
goal: to validate the HSV-1 replication phenotype observed in the primary screen
span_chunk: The HSV-1 replication phenotype observed in the primary screen was validated for a subset of candidates by deconvoluting the assay SMARTpools.

description: RNA was extracted from transfected Hela cells and mRNA levels were determined by TaqMan qPCR.
span_chunk: Hela cells were transfected with selected SMARTpool siRNAs in 96-well plates, in triplicate, as described. After 48 h transfection, medium was removed, cells rinsed in PBS and lysed in 100 µl TRIZOL (Invitrogen). mRNA levels were determined by TaqMan qPCR, using the one-step RT-qPCR kit (Thermofisher), with gene-specific primers.

description: Proteins were expressed in HEK293 cells, lysed, and incubated with magnetic beads for pull-down assay to validate Y2H interactions.
goal: to validate Y2H protein interactions
span_chunk: Proteins were transiently expressed in HEK293 cells as hybrid proteins with the Staphylococcus aureus protein A tag or Renilla reniformis luciferase fused to their amino termini. Lysates were incubated on ice for 15 minutes. 100 µl of wash buffer (PBS, 1 mM DTT) were added per well, and 10% of the diluted lysate was removed to determine the luciferase activity present in each sample before washing.

description: Hela cells transfected with siRNA SMARTpools were infected with HSV-1-eGFP and imaged post-infection.
span_chunk: Selected siRNAs SMARTpools were diluted to 500 nM in HBSS and 40 µl was incubated with 40 µl Dharmafect 1 diluted in HBSS to a final concentration of 0.15%. After 20 min incubation, 3×10 4 Hela cells in 320 µl transfection medium were added, mixed with the transfection complexes and transferred to 8-well glass bottomed chamber slides (Becton Dickinson). Images were acquired 48 h post-infection.

description: Escherichia coli strains NEB5α and BL21(DE3) were grown in LB broth with aeration, transformed by electroporation, and transformants were selected on LB agar with antibiotics.
goal: to grow and select transformed bacterial strains
span_chunk: Escherichia coli NEB5α (New England BioLabs) and BL21(DE3) (Novagen) were grown in LB broth, Miller (Difco), with aeration at 250 rpm. Plasmids were transformed into cells by electroporation, and transformants were selected by plating on LB agar with the appropriate antibiotic and were incubated at 37°C overnight.

description: Plasmids were constructed using Gibson assembly and CloneAmp HiFi PCR Premix for DNA amplification, and prepared using an E.Z.N.A. plasmid minikit.
goal: to construct plasmids for further experiments
span_chunk: Construction of plasmids. All plasmids used in the present study are listed in Table S1 in the supplemental material... M. smegmatis DnaBi1 was inserted in-frame using Gibson assembly (NEB) into kanR... An E.Z.N.A. plasmid minikit (Omega) was used to prepare plasmids.

task_name: Kanamycin intein splicing reporter spot titers
description: KD fusions were screened in E. coli to identify candidates that required splicing for survival on kanamycin-containing media, and survivability was reported as CFU per kanamycin concentration.
goal: to screen for splicing-dependent survival on kanamycin media
span_chunk: KD fusions were screened in E. coli to identify candidates that required splicing for survival on kanamycin-containing media... The degree of survivability is reported as CFU per kanamycin concentration.

task_name: In silico analysis of KanR insertion sites
description: The 3D structure of KanR was used to analyze the context and properties of the +1 serine residues, calculating rSASA, distance to the dimer interface, and distance to the active site.
goal: to analyze the structural context of intein insertion sites
span_chunk: We used this 3D structure to analyze the context and properties of the +1 serine residues in KanR... To assess the intein insertion site characteristics, we calculated the relative solvent-accessible surface area (rSASA), the distance to the dimer interface, and the distance to the active site for each of the serine residues in KanR.

description: M. smegmatis was grown in standard media, and spot titer assays were performed to study splicing-dependent reporter using a mycobacterial shuttle vector.
goal: to perform spot titer assays with M. smegmatis
span_chunk: M. smegmatis (MC 2 155) was grown in standard 7H9 (liquid) and 7H10 (solid) media prior to spot titer assays... For spot titer studies, 7H10 was prepared without albumin or catalase.

description: The MIG reporter was expressed in BL21(DE3), and zinc-mediated inhibition of intein splicing was measured, including a reversibility test with EDTA.
goal: to measure zinc-mediated inhibition of intein splicing
span_chunk: Zinc-mediated inhibition of M. smegmatis DnaBi1 and M. leprae DnaB intein splicing was measured using our MIG reporter... To verify that zinc-mediated splicing inhibition was reversible, following 1-h incubation with zinc, samples were treated with a 2× excess of EDTA and incubated further as indicated.

task_name: Crystal structure determination of zinc-bound DnaBi1
description: M. smegmatis DnaBi1-zinc crystals were grown using a hanging-drop vapor diffusion method and the crystal structure was determined by molecular replacement and further refined.
goal: to determine the crystal structure of zinc-bound DnaBi1
span_chunk: The purification and structure determination of the zinc-bound DnaBi1 were performed using methods similar to those previously used for the apo M. smegmatis DnaBi1 intein... The crystal structure of M. smegmatis DnaB1 intein-zinc was solved by molecular replacement using Phaser (Phenix version 1.12-2829) with PDB ID 6BS8 as the starting model.

description: Design variable length probes (50- to 100-mers) at a 5-bp step across the entire sequence space, repeat-mask probes, compare probe set to target sequence, and eliminate probes with more than 25 matches in the target set.
span_chunk: Variable length probes (50- to 100-mers) were generated at a 5-bp step across the entire sequence space. Individual probes were repeat-masked by removing probes that had an average 15-mer frequency >200... Probe sequences with more than 25 matches in the target set were eliminated from consideration.

description: Hybridize two slides of the array design for 4 days with four barley cultivars using standard CGH protocols.
span_chunk: Two slides of this array design were hybridized for 4 days with four barley cultivars (Steptoe (Cy3) versus Barke (Cy5), Morex (Cy3) versus Bowman (Cy5)) using standard CGH protocols.

description: Remove probes with high signal intensity as missed repetitive elements and exclude probes as contaminants or non-performing based on low signal for all four cultivars.
span_chunk: Based on the CGH results, 0.42% of the probes were removed as missed repetitive elements based on high signal intensity. An additional 2.16% of the probes were excluded as contaminants or non-performing, based on low signal for all four cultivars.

description: Prepare Illumina TruSeq Paired End libraries, fragment genomic DNA, perform size fractionation if necessary, purify the libraries, and amplify using pre-capture LM-PCR.
span_chunk: Illumina TruSeq Paired End libraries (Illumina Part # 15026486) were prepared... 1 μg genomic DNA was fragmented... Libraries were utilized either with or without size fractionation... The TruSeq DNA libraries were purified... To enrich for correctly ligated DNA fragments, 20 μl of the TruSeq DNA library were used as template in the pre-capture LM-PCR reaction.

task_name: Capture library and liquid array processing
description: Add Plant Capture Enhancer to the amplified sample library, block adapter segments during hybridization, pool samples with different indexes, perform hybridization, and purify captured DNA using Streptavidin Dynabeads.
span_chunk: Prior to hybridization 10 μl of Roche NimbleGen's (Madison, WI, USA) proprietary Plant Capture Enhancer (PCE) were added to a 1.5-ml tube containing 1 μg of the amplified sample library... Up to six samples provided with different indexes were pooled for hybridization... The hybridization sample (15 μl) was incubated... Streptavidin Dynabeads (M-270, Invitrogen) were thoroughly vortexed, aliquoted (50 μl per hybridization) into 1.5-ml tubes and prepared for the affinity purification of captured DNA.

description: Amplify the bead-bound captured library using LM-PCR, clean-up the reactions using the Qiaquick PCR purification kit, and analyze the library fragments.
span_chunk: The bead-bound captured library was amplified using LM-PCR... Both LM-PCR reactions were combined and cleaned-up using the Qiaquick PCR purification kit... Libraries were analyzed electrophoretically using the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.

description: Map target regions against the WGS assembly, compute coverage, perform regression analysis, compare regions with high coverage, call SNPs, and visualize SNP frequency.
span_chunk: Target regions derived from transcript contigs... were mapped against the WGS assembly of barley cultivar ‘Morex’... Coverage was computed with SAMtools depth... Regression analysis of sequencing output, read coverage and the number of detected SNPs was performed... SNP calling was performed with SAMtools mpileup/BCFtools.

description: Filter variant positions and genotype calls, calculate the Hamming distance between samples, and construct a neighbor-joining tree.
span_chunk: Variant positions and genotype calls were filtered... The Hamming distance (i.e. the number of different genotype calls) was calculated between any two samples. The resulting distance matrix was used to construct a neighbor-joining tree.

task_name: Replacement of fliG gene with pHluorin(M153R)-fliG allele
description: Using the λ Red homologous recombination system to replace the fliG gene on the chromosome with a pHluorin(M153R)-fliG allele.
span_chunk: The fliG gene on the chromosome is replaced by a pHluorin(M153R)-fliG allele using the λ Red homologous recombination system.

task_name: Preparation of L broth and T broth
description: Preparing L broth (LB) and T broth (TB) according to previously described methods, with the addition of ampicillin and arabinose to the medium.
span_chunk: L broth (LB) was prepared as described before. T broth (TB) contained 10 g of Bacto tryptone and 5 g of NaCl per liter. Ampicillin and arabinose were added to the medium at final concentrations of 100 µg/ml and 0.02% (wt/vol), respectively.

description: Carrying out DNA manipulations and sequencing reactions using BigDye v3.1, followed by analysis with a 3130 Genetic Analyzer.
span_chunk: DNA manipulations were carried out as described before. DNA sequencing reactions were carried out using BigDye v3.1 as described in the manufacturer’s instructions, and then the reaction mixtures were analyzed by a 3130 Genetic Analyzer.

description: Growing Salmonella cells, washing with motility buffer, incubating, centrifuging to obtain cell pellets and culture supernatants, and performing immunoblotting with specific antibodies.
span_chunk: Flagellar protein export assay. Salmonella cells were grown...and heated at 95°C for 5 min. After SDS-PAGE, immunoblotting with polyclonal anti-FlgD and anti-FliC antibodies was performed as described before.

task_name: Purification of pHluorin(M153R) and its variants
description: Purifying pHluorin(M153R) and pHluorin(M153R)-FliG-His from BL21(DE3)pLysS strains carrying specific plasmids using affinity chromatography.
span_chunk: pHluorin(M153R) was purified from the soluble fractions...pHluorin(M153R)-FliG-His was purified by nickel-nitrilotriacetic acid (Ni-NTA) affinity chromatography from the soluble fractions of BL21(DE3)pLysS carrying pYVM013 as described before.

description: Observing Salmonella cells expressing various pHluorin(M153R) constructs under a custom-built fluorescence microscope and capturing images with an EMCCD camera.
span_chunk: Fluorescence microscopy. Salmonella cells expressing pHluorin(M153R), pHluorin(M153R)-FliG...Each fluorescent image was captured by the EMCCD camera.

task_name: Determination of cytoplasmic pH using pH imaging system
description: Measuring bulk and local cytoplasmic pH of Salmonella cells by analyzing fluorescence intensity ratios from captured images and using a standard curve for calibration.
span_chunk: Determination of cytoplasmic pH using pH imaging system. Bulk cytoplasmic pH...The pH was determined using the standard curve obtained from purified pHluorin(M153R) or purified pHluorin(M153R)-FliG.

task_name: Determination of local pH around the export apparatus
description: Capturing fluorescence images, determining fluorescence intensity of pHluorin(M153R)-FliG spots, and calculating local pH using a calibration curve.
span_chunk: Determination of the local pH around the export apparatus. Each fluorescence image was captured...The local pH was determined by the 410/470 ratio of each fluorescent spot.

task_name: Cryo-EM and image processing of HBBs
description: Preparing hook-basal bodies (HBBs), collecting cryo-EM images, and processing images for 3D reconstruction of HBB structures.
span_chunk: Cryo-EM and image processing. Hook-basal bodies (HBBs) with the C ring attached were prepared...Three-dimensional (3D) image reconstitution of the wild-type and pHluorin(M153R)-labeled HBB structures was carried out using the REFINE program with c100 symmetry.

description: Collecting images of minicells at liquid-nitrogen temperature, performing 3D reconstructions, and calculating subtomogram averages.
span_chunk: Electron cryotomography and subtomogram averaging. Minicells of the Salmonella wild-type strain and the Δ fliH-fliI flhB(P28T) bypass mutant were prepared...3D reconstructions were calculated using the IMOD software package.

description: Seeds of various genotypes of Phaseolus vulgaris were sown in vermiculite, grown in a growth chamber, and transplanted into plastic pots.
span_chunk: Seeds were sown in vermiculite and grown in a growth chamber at 23°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle and 75% relative humidity. Seedlings were cultivated in plastic pots filled with moist vermiculite during 10–12 days (the stage at which primary leaves are fully-expanded). Three seedlings were then transplanted in moist vermiculite in a 20 cm plastic pot and placed in a dark room 24 h prior to inoculation.

description: A population of 77 F11 recombinant inbred lines (RILs) derived from a cross between JaloEEP558 and BAT93 was used for genetic mapping of the R-BPMV resistance gene.
goal: to map the R-BPMV resistance gene
span_chunk: For genetic mapping experiments, a population of 77 F11 RILs, derived from the cross between JaloEEP558 and BAT93 was used to map the R-BPMV resistance gene.

description: RNA2-derived plasmids were constructed by inserting P. vulgaris target gene fragments or synthetic oligonucleotides into the Bam H1 restriction site of pBPMV-IA-V1.
span_chunk: All others RNA2-derived plasmids were constructed in our laboratory by insertion of P. vulgaris target gene fragments in the Bam H1 restriction site of pBPMV-IA-V1. For construction of BPMV-PvPDS-52 bp, we directly cloned a double-stranded synthetic oligonucleotide (Table 3) into the Bam H1 restriction site.

task_name: Amplification and cloning of gene fragments
description: Target gene fragments were amplified by PCR, digested with Bam H1, and inserted into Bam H1-digested and dephosphorylated pBPMV-IA-V1 to generate VIGS vectors.
goal: to generate VIGS vectors
span_chunk: For all other BPMV-derived vectors, target gene fragments were first amplified by PCR using specific primers (Table 3), P. vulgaris cDNAs as template, and a high fidelity polymerase (Advantage HF2, Clontech). PCR products were digested with Bam H1 and inserted into Bam H1-digested and dephosphorylated pBPMV-IA-V1 to generate the VIGS vectors listed in Table 1.

description: Plants were placed in the dark before inoculation, and primary inoculation was performed with a DNA-plasmid mix, while secondary inoculations used leaf sap from infected leaves.
span_chunk: All plants were placed in the dark 24 h prior to inoculation... For primary inoculation, a DNA-plasmid mix was prepared... For secondary inoculations, an infected leaf of P. vulgaris cv. Black Valentine (fresh leaf or frozen leaf conserved at -80°C) was ground in a mortar with mock buffer to make leaf sap.

description: The conditions for rub-inoculation of BPMV-derived plasmids were optimized by varying the amount of plasmid DNA and the intensity of rubbing.
span_chunk: A 20 μL plasmid DNA mix containing equal amounts (either 1.5, 3, or 5 μg) of pBPMV-IA-R1M and either pBPMV-IA-V1 or pBPMV-GFP2, was prepared using mock buffer. Three intensities of rubbing were evaluated: low-intensity (one passage of the gloved finger per leaf surface), medium-intensity (two passages) and high-intensity (three passages).

description: GFP expression in aerial organs and roots was examined using a UV lamp and photographed, while microscopic observations of roots were made using an Axioskop microscope.
span_chunk: GFP expression in aerial organs and roots was examined using a UV lamp... and photographed using a Canon PowerShot A2300 digital camera. Microscopic observations of roots were made at 21 dpi using an Axioskop microscope (Zeiss, Germany) and photographed using a RT KE camera (SPOT, USA).

description: Total RNA and cDNA synthesis were performed, and semi-quantitative RT-PCR was used to analyze the expression of the PvPDS gene and PvUBI as an internal control.
goal: to analyze the expression of the PvPDS gene
span_chunk: Total RNA and cDNA synthesis were performed as described in Richard et al. [42]. Primer sequences are listed in Table 3... After 25 cycles, PCR products were analysed using analytical agarose-ethidium bromide electrophoresis.

task_name: Genetic mapping of the R-BPMV gene
description: The R-BPMV resistance gene was mapped using the MAPMAKER software and an integrated linkage map of common bean with a set of 142 markers.
goal: to map the R-BPMV resistance gene
span_chunk: The MAPMAKER software version 3.0 [43] was used to map the R-BPMV resistance gene on the integrated linkage map of common bean using the set of 142 markers [44] as described in Geffroy et al. [45].

description: TO1-Dtb and TO3-Dtb were synthesized using TO1-acetate and TO3-acetate, respectively, with EZ link amine PEG 4 desthiobiotin as precursors.
span_chunk: Synthesis of desthiobiotin derivatives of thiazole orange acetate TO1 PEG 4 desthiobiotin (TO1-Dtb) and TO3 PEG 4 desthiobiotin (TO3-Dtb) were synthesized using TO1-acetate and TO3-acetate, respectively, together with EZ link amine PEG 4 desthiobiotin (Thermo Fisher) as precursors.

description: Product identity was confirmed by electrospray ionization–mass spectrometry in the positive mode.
span_chunk: Product identity was confirmed by electrospray ionization–mass spectrometry in the positive mode.

description: Streptavidin agarose beads were washed and incubated with TO1-Dtb to prepare derivatized affinity resin.
span_chunk: Preparation of TO1-Dtb derivatized streptavidin agarose affinity resin In all experiments, streptavidin agarose beads (Invitrogen) were used for batch purification in either 1.7 mL or 5 mL tubes, as required, and solutions containing the beads were mixed using a rotator.

description: The yeast U1 M strain was prepared, transformed with the U1 M plasmid, and yeast whole-cell extracts were prepared using the liquid N2 method and a ball mill.
span_chunk: Yeast strain and extract preparation The yeast U1 M strain was prepared from the BJ2168 derivative yAAH0441... Yeast whole-cell extracts were prepared from strains yAAH1204 and yAAH1362 as previously described using the liquid N2 method and a ball mill.

task_name: SNAP labeling of yeast whole-cell extract
description: Yeast whole-cell extracts were fluorescently tagged with SNAP-Surface 549 tag and other reagents.
span_chunk: SNAP labeling of yeast whole-cell extract Yeast whole-cell extracts (500 µL) were first fluorescently tagged with the SNAP-Surface 549 tag (NEB) by incubating the extracts with 1 U/µL Murine RNase inhibitor (NEB), Protease Inhibitors (cOmplete mini at the recommended concentration, EDTA Free, Sigma), 5 mM DTT together with 5 µM SNAP-Surface 549 tag in Buffer B at RT for 30 min.

description: Yeast whole-cell extracts were added to TO1-Dtb saturated agarose beads, incubated, washed, and snRNP was eluted with biotin.
span_chunk: Pull-down of U1 M-associated snRNPs Yeast whole-cell extracts (500 µL of extract either with or without SNAP label) were added to 200 µL of TO1-Dtb saturated agarose beads and incubated at 4°C for 1 h in a rotator.

description: RNA was analyzed by RT-primer extension assay using Maxima Reverse Transcriptase and electrophoresis.
span_chunk: RNA analysis by RT-primer extension and solution hybridization Either 1 µL of the precipitated RNA or 1 µg of total RNA isolated from WT yeast extract was added to the corresponding 5′ [32P]-labeled primers and the reverse transcription reaction was then carried out using the Maxima Reverse Transcriptase (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 45°C for 1 h.

description: The 6S RDM plasmid was constructed with point mutations and cloned into the pEcoli-Cterm-6xHN plasmid.
span_chunk: Construction of the p6SRDM_T7 plasmid The 6S RDM plasmid was created as previously described but with point mutations corresponding to the R9-33 construct.

task_name: Expression of 6S RDM RNA in E. coli
description: The 6S RDM RNA was expressed in E. coli BL21 (DE3) cells and native extract was prepared.
span_chunk: Expression of the 6S RDM RNA in E. coli and extract preparation The 6S RDM RNA was expressed in E. coli BL21 (DE3) cells transformed with the p6SRDM_T7 plasmid.

task_name: Purification of 6S RNA RDM RNP complexes
description: 6S RDM associated RNPs were purified from E. coli native extract using TO1-Dtb derivatized agarose beads.
span_chunk: Purification of 6S RNA RDM RNP complexes For the purification of 6S RDM associated RNPs, 3.8 mL of E. coli native extract, was made up to 5 mL final volume by the addition of 1 mL of 5× Buffer B and supplemented with final concentrations of Heparin at 75 µg/mL and DTT at 0.75 mM.

task_name: 6S RDM RNP complex fractionation by SEC
description: The biotin eluate was loaded onto a Superdex 200 Prep Grade column for size-exclusion chromatography.
span_chunk: 6S RDM RNP complex fractionation by size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) This biotin eluate (380 µL) was loaded onto a manually packed Superdex 200 Prep Grade (GE Healthcare) column (30 × 1 cm) and eluted with Buffer B using a flow rate of 0.1 mL/min.

task_name: Mass spectrometry analysis of 6S RDM RNP complexes
description: Samples were analyzed using LC–MS/MS and data were processed with MaxQuant software.
span_chunk: Mass spectrometry analysis of 6S RDM RNP complexes and commercial RNAP Samples were analyzed at the University of British Columbia Proteomics Core Facility.

task_name: Maintaining and synchronizing C. elegans strains
description: Animals were maintained using standard culture conditions and synchronized through alkaline hypochlorite treatment to isolate eggs.
span_chunk: Animals were maintained using standard culture conditions at 25° ( Brenner 1974 ) and were synchronized through alkaline hypochlorite treatment of gravid adults to isolate eggs ( Porta-de-la-Riva et al. 2012 ).

description: SapTrap was used to construct the repair template for generating the knock-in into the nhr-25 gene.
span_chunk: SapTrap was used to construct the 30xlinker::GFP^SEC^TEV::AID degron::3xFLAG repair template (pJW1747) for generating the knock-in into the 3′ end of the nhr-25 gene ( Schwartz and Jorgensen 2016 ).

description: The pJW1747 repair template was purified using the Invitrogen PureLink HQ Mini Plasmid DNA Purification Kit.
span_chunk: The pJW1747 repair template was purified using the Invitrogen PureLink HQ Mini Plasmid DNA Purification Kit (K210001).

description: N2 animals were injected with a mix of the repair template, Cas9 vector, and co-injection markers.
span_chunk: N2 animals were injected with a mix consisting of 10 ng/µL of pJW1747, 50 ng/µL of pDD121 (Cas9 vector), and co-injection markers (10 ng/µL pGH8, 5 ng/µL pCFJ104, 2.5 ng/µL pCFJ90).

description: Knock-ins were isolated and each knock-in junction was verified via PCR.
span_chunk: Knock-ins were isolated as previously described ( Dickinson et al. 2015 ). Each knock-in junction was verified via PCR using a primer that bound outside the homology arm paired with a primer binding within pJW1747.

description: The knock-in was backcrossed against wild-type N2 animals and the SEC was excised by heat-shock.
span_chunk: The knock-in was backcrossed five times against wild-type N2 animals to produce JDW58. The SEC was then excised by heat-shock ( Dickinson et al. 2015 ) to produce JDW59.

task_name: Crossing strains to generate new strain
description: JDW58 was crossed to CA1200 to generate JDW70, and the SEC was excised to produce JDW71.
span_chunk: JDW58 was crossed to CA1200 ( eft-3 > TIR1 :: mRuby ) to generate JDW70. The SEC was then excised ( Dickinson et al. 2015 ) to produce JDW71.

description: Synchronized L1 larval stage animals were transferred to NGM agar plates or M9 buffer containing different forms of auxin for degradation experiments.
span_chunk: For all auxin experiments, synchronized L1 larval stage animals were first transferred to standard nematode growth media (NGM) agar plates seeded with E. coli OP50 and then transferred at the P6.p 2-cell stage (mid-L3 stage) to either OP50-seeded NGM agar plates treated with IAA, NAA, or K-NAA, or M9 buffer containing NAA in the absence of bacteria, NAA plus E. coli NA22, or K-NAA plus E. coli NA22.

description: L4 hermaphrodites were picked onto individual plates, transferred daily, and progeny were counted and scored for viability.
span_chunk: Brood size and viability assays were performed as described ( Zhang et al. 2015 ). Briefly, L4 hermaphrodites were picked onto individual MYOB plates containing 0% ethanol (K-NAA control), 0.25% ethanol (IAA control), 4 mM K-NAA, or 4 mM IAA. Animals were then transferred to new plates daily over 4 days.

description: RNAi targeting cul-1 was constructed and fed to animals to silence specific genes.
span_chunk: RNAi targeting cul-1 was constructed by cloning 997 bp of synthetic DNA based on its cDNA sequence available on WormBase ( wormbase.org ) into the highly efficient T444T RNAi vector.

description: Animals were grown on control or NAA plates and imaged to score for the presence or absence of anchor cells.
span_chunk: Synchronized L1 stage eft-3 > TIR1 :: mRuby ; nhr-25 :: GFP :: AID animals were plated onto OP50 NGM agar plates containing either control or 4 mM NAA and grown for 24 hr at 25° until the early L3 stage (P6.p 1-cell stage), after the normal time of AC specification.

description: Images were acquired using various microscopy techniques and processed using Fiji software for analysis.
span_chunk: Images were acquired using a Hamamatsu Orca EM-CCD camera and a Borealis-modified Yokagawa CSU-10 spinning disk confocal microscope... All acquired images were processed using Fiji software (version: 2.0.0-rc-69/1.52p).

description: Performing peptidomics analysis on soybean xylem exudate to identify mobile peptides.
span_chunk: Through a peptidomics analysis of soybean (Glycine max) xylem exudate, we previously identified multiple root-to-shoot long-distance mobile peptides.

task_name: Nano-LC–MS/MS analysis of Arabidopsis xylem exudate
description: Collecting Arabidopsis xylem exudate and performing nano-liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry to detect the presence of CLE2 peptide.
goal: To explore whether the Arabidopsis CLE peptide is translocated from roots to shoots via the xylem.
span_chunk: To explore whether the Arabidopsis CLE peptide is translocated from roots to shoots via the xylem, we collected Arabidopsis xylem exudate and performed nano-liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (nano-LC–MS/MS) analysis.

task_name: Expression analysis of CLE2 under low-carbon conditions
description: Analyzing the expression of CLE2 in plants treated with a photosynthesis inhibitor or prolonged darkness to determine its response to low-carbon conditions.
goal: To examine whether CLE2 responds to low-carbon conditions.
span_chunk: To examine whether CLE2 responds to low-carbon conditions, expression analysis of CLE2 was performed on plants treated with the photosynthesis inhibitor 3-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)-1,1-dimethylurea (DCMU) or prolonged darkness.

task_name: Generation of cle2cle3 and cle1-7 mutants
description: Using CRISPR/Cas9 technology to generate cle2cle3 double mutant and cle1-7 septuple mutant plants for functional analysis.
goal: To fully analyze the functions of CLE peptides.
span_chunk: To fully analyze the functions, we then generated a cle2cle3 double mutant and a cle1-7 septuple mutant using clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)/CRISPR-associated protein 9 (Cas9) technology.

task_name: Measurement of sugar and starch contents
description: Measuring sugar (sucrose and glucose) and starch contents in the roots and leaves of plants to characterize the functions of CLE2.
goal: To characterize the functions of CLE2.
span_chunk: To characterize the functions of CLE2, sugar (sucrose and glucose) and starch contents in the roots and leaves were measured.

description: Conducting a gain-of-function analysis by using the CoYMV promoter to drive CLE2 expression in transgenic lines and measuring sucrose levels.
goal: To further characterize the effect of CLEs.
span_chunk: To further characterize the effect of CLEs, we conducted a gain-of-function analysis of CLE2.

description: Applying synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to Arabidopsis plants and measuring starch and sugar contents in shoots and roots.
span_chunk: Furthermore, the synthetic mature CLE2 peptide was transiently applied to Arabidopsis.

task_name: Evaluation of shoot and root mass
description: Evaluating shoot and root mass in cle1-7 mutant plants under different light conditions and sucrose availability.
goal: To explore the effect of decreased root sucrose levels on root growth.
span_chunk: To explore this possibility, we evaluated shoot and root mass in the cle1-7 mutant.

task_name: Quantitative expression analysis of sucrose-related genes
description: Analyzing the expression of genes involved in sucrose transport, synthesis, and degradation in leaves and roots of different plant lines.
goal: To explore the effect of the CLE genes on root sucrose content at the molecular level.
span_chunk: To explore the effect of the CLE genes on root sucrose content at the molecular level, quantitative expression analysis of genes involved in sucrose transport, synthesis, and degradation in leaves and roots was conducted.

description: Performing grafting experiments to combine roots and shoots of WT and cle1-7 plants to study the regulation of SUC2 expression.
goal: To explore if root-derived CLE peptides affect shoots.
span_chunk: To explore this possibility, we performed grafting experiments to combine the roots and shoots of WT and cle1-7 plants.

task_name: Analyzing telomere dysfunction in stn1 mutants
description: Analyze the severity of growth defects and genome instability in stn1 mutants across different generations and correlate with telomere length.
goal: to describe the occurrence of growth defects and genome instability
span_chunk: In our previous work we noticed that telomere dysfunction in Arabidopsis stn1 mutants is less pronounced in plants with longer telomeres [31]. These data were obtained by analyzing stn1 mutants derived from a cross between ecotypes with short (Col-0, 2–4 kb) and long (Ws, 4–8 kb) telomeres.

task_name: Quantifying telomeric DNA by dot blot hybridization
description: Detect and quantify the amount of telomeric DNA in stn1 mutants across different generations using dot blot hybridization.
goal: to quantify the amount of telomeric DNA
span_chunk: We also detected a further decline in the amount of telomeric DNA by dot blot hybridization in G2 and G3 stn1 (C).

task_name: Assessing EXO1 effect on STN1-null telomeres
description: Analyze the developmental defects and fertility in exo1a exo1b stn1 mutants to assess the impact of EXO1 on telomere dysfunction.
goal: to assess the effect of EXO1 on STN1-null telomeres
span_chunk: To assess the effect of EXO1 on STN1-null telomeres, we analyzed exo1a exo1b stn1 mutants where both Arabidopsis EXO1 paralogues have been disrupted.

description: Evaluate the transcriptional upregulation of DNA repair genes in exo1 stn1 plants.
goal: to demonstrate that EXO1 exacerbates genome instability and DNA damage response after STN1 loss
span_chunk: Expression of these genes is reduced in exo1 stn1 plants, which further demonstrates that EXO1 exacerbates genome instability and DNA damage response after STN1 loss.

description: Compare the G-overhang size in stn1 and exo1 stn1 plants using the in gel hybridization technique.
goal: to directly assay for telomere resection
span_chunk: To directly assay for telomere resection, we compared the relative G-overhang size in stn1 and exo1 stn1 plants by the in gel hybridization technique.

description: Quantify the frequency of telomeric permutations forming the chromosome termini in stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants using adaptor ligation-mediated PCR coupled with Illumina sequencing.
goal: to examine whether the sequence alteration in STN1-depleted plants is caused by EXO1
span_chunk: To examine whether the sequence alteration in STN1-depleted plants is caused by EXO1, we quantified the frequency of telomeric permutations forming the chromosome termini in stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants by adaptor ligation-mediated PCR coupled with Illumina sequencing.

description: Generate stn1 mutants with a disruption of the telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT) gene to study the role of telomerase in telomere maintenance.
goal: to test the hypothesis that telomerase partially compensates for the loss of telomeric DNA in stn1 mutants
span_chunk: To test this hypothesis, we generated telomerase-null stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants that carry a disruption of the telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT) gene.

description: Perform terminal restriction fragment (TRF) analysis to assess telomere length and heterogeneity in DNA polymerase α mutants.
goal: to assess the impact of DNA polymerase α mutations on telomere maintenance
span_chunk: To assess the impact of DNA polymerase α mutations on telomere maintenance, we performed TRF analysis.

description: Use a fusion PCR strategy with primers specific to subtelomeric regions to detect chromosome end-to-end fusions in DNA polymerase α mutants.
goal: to determine whether some of the anaphase bridges arise from chromosome-end-to-end fusions
span_chunk: Since polymerase α deficiency is expected to cause genome-wide chromosome instabilities, we next determined whether some of the anaphase bridges detected in pol α and icu2-1 mutants arise from chromosome-end-to-end fusions by using a fusion PCR strategy that utilizes primers specific to subtelomeric regions.

description: Analyze the abundance of t-circles in DNA polymerase α mutants using the t-circle amplification assay.
goal: to examine whether DNA polymerase α mutants exhibit aberrant telomeric recombination
span_chunk: To examine whether this is also the case in DNA polymerase α mutants, we analyzed t-circle abundance with the t-circle amplification assay.

task_name: Measuring nuclear DNA content by flow cytometry
description: Measure the impact of STN1 deficiency on the nuclear DNA content in stn1 atxr5 atxr6 plants using flow cytometry.
goal: to determine whether STN1 plays a role in genome-wide replication
span_chunk: We generated stn1 atxr5 atxr6 plants and measured the impact of STN1 deficiency on the nuclear DNA content by flow cytometry.

task_name: Sequencing genomic DNA from sorted nuclei
description: Use Illumina sequencing to analyze genomic DNA from sorted 8C nuclei and quantify the density of reads mapped along the individual Arabidopsis chromosomes.
goal: to determine whether STN1 is required for re-replication of particular genomic regions
span_chunk: To determine whether STN1 is required for re-replication of particular genomic regions, we used Illumina sequencing to analyze genomic DNA from sorted 8C nuclei and quantified the density of reads mapped along the individual Arabidopsis chromosomes.

description: BALB/c mice were vaccinated twice at 6–7 week intervals with VRP-SARS-N or a control VRP expressing green fluorescent protein (VRP-GFP) intranasally (i.n.) or subcutaneously (s.c.) prior to challenge with mouse-adapted SARS-CoV.
goal: to evaluate the differences in protection against SARS-CoV challenge
span_chunk: we vaccinated BALB/c mice twice at 6–7 week intervals with VRP-SARS-N or a control VRP expressing green fluorescent protein (VRP-GFP) i.n. or subcutaneously (s.c.) prior to challenge

task_name: Assessment of CD4+ T cell response
description: The CD4+ T cell response was assessed in the lungs, airways, and spleen after intranasal and subcutaneous inoculation with VRP-SARS-N.
goal: to determine the localization and magnitude of the N-specific CD4+ T cell response
span_chunk: Only i.n. inoculation with VRP-SARS-N induced an N-specific CD4+ T cell response in the lungs and airways, which was increased by i.n. VRP-SARS-N boosting

task_name: Depletion of memory CD4+ T cells
description: Memory CD4+ T cells were depleted systemically 2 days prior to challenge to assess their role in protection.
goal: to confirm the importance of memory CD4+ T cells in protection against SARS-CoV challenge
span_chunk: Next we assessed the role of memory CD4+ T cells in protection by depleting them systemically 2 days prior to challenge.

task_name: Labeling of respiratory tract CD4+ T cells
description: Cells were simultaneously labeled by intravenous and intranasal administration of CD90.2 and CD45 antibodies, respectively, to discriminate between cells localized to the airway versus those in the parenchyma and vasculature.
goal: to distinguish between the localization of CD4+ T cells in the respiratory tract
span_chunk: To discriminate between cells localized to the airway versus those in the parenchyma and vasculature, we used a modification of a previously described method to simultaneously label cells by i.v. and i.n. administration of CD90.2 and CD45 antibodies

task_name: Intranasal depletion of CD4+ T cells
description: CD4+ T cells in the airways were depleted by intranasal administration of anti-CD4+ T cell antibody prior to challenge to explicitly address their role in protection.
goal: to determine the contribution of airway CD4+ T cells to protection against SARS-CoV
span_chunk: To address more explicitly the role of airway cells in protection, we depleted CD4+ T cells in the airways, but not the parenchyma or vasculature, by i.n. administration of 10 μg anti-CD4+ T cell antibody prior to challenge

description: IFN-γ mRNA levels were measured in the lungs of VRP-SARS-N-immunized mice by day 1 post-infection.
goal: to probe the mechanism of action of CD4+ T cells in protection
span_chunk: higher IFN-γ mRNA levels were detected in the lungs of VRP-SARS-N-immunized mice by day 1 p.i.

task_name: Assessment of respiratory dendritic cell migration
description: The migration of respiratory dendritic cells (rDCs) to mediastinal lymph nodes was assessed after VRP-SARS-N immunization.
goal: to determine the effect of airway memory CD4+ T cells on rDC migration
span_chunk: We next assessed whether airway memory CD4+ T cells participated in these processes.

task_name: Analysis of CD8+ T cell mobilization
description: The frequency, numbers, and functionality of lung CD8+ T cells recognizing epitope S366 were analyzed after SARS-CoV challenge in VRP-SARS-N-immunized mice.
goal: to assess the role of airway memory CD4+ T cells in the enhanced CD8+ T cell response
span_chunk: SARS-CoV challenge of VRP-SARS-N-immunized mice resulted in an increase in frequency and numbers of lung CD8+ T cells that recognized epitope S366

description: IL-10 expression by SARS-N353-specific CD4+ T cells in the lung was analyzed after direct ex vivo or in vivo stimulation.
goal: to determine the contribution of IL-10 to protection in VRP-SARS-N-immunized mice
span_chunk: i.n. VRP-SARS-N vaccination induced IL-10 expression by SARS-N353-specific CD4+ T cells in the lung after direct ex vivo or in vivo stimulation.

description: Eosinophil infiltration into the lungs was assessed after VRP-SARS-N immunization and challenge.
goal: to evaluate the potential immunopathological effects of VRP-SARS-N immunization
span_chunk: However, we could find no evidence of an eosinophilic infiltration into the lungs of either young or aged mice after i.n. or s.c. VRP-SARS-N immunization and challenge

task_name: Evaluation of cross-reactive CD4+ T cell responses
description: Cross-reactive memory CD4+ T cell responses were evaluated after immunization with VRP-MERS-N and challenge with SARS-CoV.
goal: to determine if cross-reactive CD4+ T cells are protective against SARS-CoV
span_chunk: we next asked whether these epitopes induced cross-reactive memory CD4+ T cells in the airway.

description: LMD was performed to isolate specific cell types from formalin-fixed/paraffin-embedded tissue.
span_chunk: LMD was performed using a Zeiss/PALM Microscope (Oberkochen, Germany) from formalin-fixed/paraffin-embedded tissue as described in the Supplementary materials and methods.

description: SMA staining was performed to identify target cell types using an automated stainer.
span_chunk: SMA staining [mouse monoclonal; M851 (Dako, Glostrup, Denmark), 1 : 1000] was performed using an IntelliPATH automated stainer (Menarini, Florence, Italy) and the manufacturer's standard conditions.

description: MCF7 and HB2 cells were cultured, and stable GFP expression was conferred by transfection with a GFP expression vector.
span_chunk: MCF7 and HB2 cells were obtained from the European Collection of Cell Cultures. Stable GFP expression was conferred by pTH-GFPa 23, a selectable GFP expression vector.

description: Primary fibroblasts were isolated and immortalized by hTERT retroviral transduction.
span_chunk: Primary fibroblasts were isolated from breast surgical samples 24 and immortalized by hTERT retroviral transduction as described previously 25.

description: Reverse transfection of pre-/anti-miR and/or plasmids was performed using HiPerFect.
span_chunk: Reverse transfection of pre-/anti-miR (Ambion, Carlsbad, CA, USA) and/or plasmids was performed using HiPerFect (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany).

description: Stable miR-26b/control knock-down was performed using pmiRZIP lentiviral vectors.
span_chunk: Stable miR-26b/control ‘knock-down’ was performed using pmiRZIP lentiviral vectors (System Biosciences, Mountain View, USA).

description: Assays for cell viability, cell cycle, apoptosis, migration, and invasion were performed.
span_chunk: Assays for cell viability, cell cycle, apoptosis, migration, and invasion were performed as described previously 16, 26.

description: Flow-cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting were performed on specific machines.
span_chunk: Flow-cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting were performed on LSRII (BD Biosciences, Franklin Lakes, NJ, USA) and MoFlo (Dako) machines, respectively.

description: Spheroid invasion assays were carried out and analyzed using histological techniques.
span_chunk: Spheroid invasion assays were carried out using modifications of a previously described method 27.

description: Dual luciferase assays were used to measure gene expression.
span_chunk: Dual luciferase assays and pmiRGLO reporter were used (Promega, Fitchburg, WI, USA).

description: RNA was extracted from FFPE and cell lines, and qPCR analyses were performed.
span_chunk: RecoverAll Total Nucleic Acid Isolation for FFPE (Ambion) was used for RNA extraction from FFPE. MirVana miRNA Isolation (Ambion) and RNeasy (Qiagen) were used for extraction from cell lines of miRNA and mRNA, respectively. qPCR analyses were performed on 7500/7900HT machines in triplicate with Taqman assays (Life Technologies, Carlsbad, CA, USA).

description: Microarray analyses of miRNA expression were performed using specific arrays and reagents.
span_chunk: Microarray analyses of miRNA expression were performed using human miRNA v2 arrays and system v1.7 reagents (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA, USA).

task_name: Confirming viral vector infectivity on embryos
description: Microinject viral vectors encoding EGFP into the perivitelline space of pronuclear-stage mouse embryos and confirm EGFP expression under a fluorescence microscope at the morula/blastocyst stage.
goal: to confirm the infectivity of viral vectors on embryos
span_chunk: Therefore, each viral vector (AAV, adenoviral, and lentiviral) encoding enhanced green fluorescent protein (EGFP) driven by the CAG promoter was microinjected into the perivitelline space of pronuclear-stage mouse embryos, and the expression of EGFP was confirmed under a fluorescence microscope at the morula/blastocyst stage.

description: Compare AAV serotypes for transduction efficiency in mouse embryos and confirm the highest efficiency with AAV6.
goal: to determine the AAV serotype with the highest transduction efficiency
span_chunk: We also confirmed AAV serotypes other than serotype 6, and AAV6 showed the highest transduction efficiency (Figure S4).

task_name: Testing AAV vector infection in parthenogenetic embryos
description: Infect parthenogenetic embryos with the AAV vector to test the hypothesis of virus passing through the holes created during fertilization.
goal: to test the hypothesis of AAV vector infection through the intact zona pellucida
span_chunk: To test this hypothesis, we infected parthenogenetic embryos with the AAV vector, and unexpectedly the infection was established (Figures 1 E–1H).

task_name: Investigating large-fragment knockin with AAV vector
description: Introduce Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos by electroporation, infect with scAAV vector harboring a CAG-GFP cassette flanked by Rosa26 homology arms, and assess knockin efficiency at the blastocyst stage.
goal: to investigate the effectiveness of AAV vector for large-fragment knockin using CRISPR/Cas9 system
span_chunk: After introducing the Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos by electroporation, we infected with a self-complementary AAV (scAAV) vector harboring a 1.8-kb CAG-GFP cassette flanked by two 100-bp Rosa26 homology arms (2 kb in total).

description: Breed knockin founders with wild-type mice or rats, genotype N1 generation offspring, and confirm germline transmission.
goal: to confirm germline transmission of the knockin
span_chunk: Germline transmission was confirmed by breeding the knockin founders and wild-type C57BL/6N mice, followed by genotyping of N1 generation offsprings (Figure S7 A).

task_name: Quantifying EGFP inserts with droplet digital PCR
description: Use droplet digital PCR to quantify the number of EGFP inserts and wild-type Rosa26 alleles per cell in knockin offspring.
goal: to quantify the number of EGFP inserts and wild-type alleles per cell
span_chunk: Moreover, droplet digital PCR was used to quantify the number of EGFP inserts and wild-type (un-inserted) Rosa26 alleles per cell (Figure 3 H).

task_name: Rescuing the nude phenotype by exon exchange
description: Design gRNAs to target introns flanking exon 3 of Foxn1, generate scAAV with functional exon 3 and homology arms, introduce Cas9-RNP and scAAV into embryos, and confirm exon exchange and phenotype restoration.
goal: to rescue the nude phenotype by CRISPR/Cas9-mediated large-fragment knockin
span_chunk: To rescue the nude phenotype by exon exchange using a large-fragment knockin technique, we designed gRNAs to target 420 bp upstream (intron 2) and 550 bp downstream (intron 3) of the mutation in exon 3 and generated scAAV harboring functional exon 3 (462 bp) flanked by two homology arms (434 and 400 bp).

description: Larval brains were dissected, fixed with formaldehyde, quenched with glycine, dissociated, and resuspended.
span_chunk: Fixation and cell sorting from Drosophila larval brain Briefly, required number of larval brains after 48 h of larval hatching were dissected in PBS. After dissection, larval brains were fixed with 1% formaldehyde in PBS for 10 min at room temperature, followed by quenching of the fix with 125 mM glycine.

task_name: Cell sorting of Drosophila larval brains
description: The dissociated larval brains were sorted on BD FACSAria based on GFP strength and size to obtain a pure population of type II NSCs.
span_chunk: The cells were then sorted on BD FACSAria according to the strength of GFP and size of the NSCs, resulting in a pure population of type II NSCs.

task_name: Fixation and cell sorting of K562 cells
description: K562 cells were cultured, fixed with formaldehyde, quenched with glycine, and sorted using Hoechst stain.
span_chunk: Fixation and cell sorting of K562 cells K562 cells cultured in RPMI medium (supplemented with 10% Fetal Bovine Serum), at 37°C and 5% CO2, were fixed for 10 min at room temperature with 1% formaldehyde.

description: Fixed cells were sonicated, centrifuged, and the supernatant was incubated with specific antibodies and Dynabeads for immunoprecipitation.
span_chunk: Fixed cells (1.2 million FACS sorted NSCs per replicate) were resuspended in 140 mM RIPA and subjected to 14 cycles of sonication on a bioruptor. The extracts were incubated overnight with 2 μg of specific antibody at 4°C with head-over-tail rotations.

task_name: Washing and DNA recovery from immunoprecipitation
description: After immunoprecipitation, beads were washed, treated with RNase and Proteinase K, and DNA was extracted using phenol–chloroform.
span_chunk: The beads were separated with a magnetic rack and were washed. After the immunoprecipitation, samples were RNase-treated and subjected to Proteinase K treatment for reversal of cross-links. The samples after proteinase K treatment were subjected to phenol–chloroform extraction.

description: Recovered DNA was converted into libraries using NebNext Ultra II DNA library preparation kit following the manufacturer's protocol.
span_chunk: The recovered DNA was converted into libraries using NebNext Ultra II DNA library preparation kit, following the manufacturer’s protocol.

description: Cells were fixed, quenched, washed, sonicated, and incubated with antibody-coupled beads for TAF-ChIP, followed by tagmentation and library preparation.
span_chunk: TAF-ChIP and library preparation Cells were fixed for 10 min at room temperature with 1% formaldehyde in PBS. The formaldehyde was quenched with 125 mM glycine, for 5 min at room temperature.

task_name: Proteinase K treatment and DNA purification
description: After TAF-ChIP, samples were treated with proteinase K and DNA was purified either by phenol–chloroform extraction or direct PCR amplification.
span_chunk: The samples were subjected to proteinase K treatment in 50 μl of TE buffer, pH 8.0, with 5 μl of 20 mg/ml of proteinase K for overnight at 60°C in thermoblock with shaking at 500 rpm.

task_name: PCR amplification and purification of DNA
description: DNA was PCR-amplified using NEBNext High-Fidelity PCR Mix and purified with bead-based size selection.
span_chunk: The DNA was amplified in 100 μl reaction with 1X NEBNext High-Fidelity PCR Mix with 0.4 μM of primers containing molecular indices.

task_name: Quality control and sequencing of libraries
description: Libraries were analyzed for size distribution, concentration was measured, pooled, and sequenced on Illumina NextSeq 500.
span_chunk: After PCR purification, the libraries were analyzed on Agilent Bioanalyzer for size distribution and the concentration was measured using a Qubit fluorometer. The finished libraries were pooled in equimolar amounts and sequenced on Illumina NextSeq 500.

description: TAF and conventional ChIP libraries were used to check enrichment with various primer pairs on a real-time PCR machine.
span_chunk: TAF-ChIP and conventional ChIP-qPCR 2 μl of TAF as well as conventional ChIP library was used for checking enrichment with various primer pairs on Applied Biosystem ViiA 7 real-time machine using SYBR green reagent.

task_name: Demultiplexing and mapping of sequencing reads
description: Sequencing reads were demultiplexed, converted to fastq files, and mapped to reference genomes using bowtie2.
span_chunk: Demultiplexing and fastq file conversion were performed using blc2fastq. Reads from ChIP-Seq libraries were mapped using bowtie2.

description: Crossing the Pax2-Cre line with the R26R-Lyn-Venus line to produce fluorescence reporter mice.
span_chunk: For live-imaging analysis, we used fluorescence reporter mice produced by crossing the Pax2-Cre line [...] and R26R-Lyn-Venus line [...].

description: Sacrificing mice by cervical dislocation at E15.5 or E16.5 to collect samples.
span_chunk: All mice were sacrificed by cervical dislocation to minimize suffering at E15.5 or E16.5.

task_name: Preparing antibodies and fixatives for immunostaining
description: Using primary antibodies and fixatives (PFA or TCA) for immunostaining specific proteins.
span_chunk: We used the following primary antibodies at 1:200 as a standard condition: rabbit monoclonal anti-E-cadherin [...], mouse monoclonal anti-γ-tubulin, [...]. We used paraformaldehyde (PFA) as fixative for anti-E-cadherin, anti-γ-tubulin and anti-pHH3 immunostaining; we used trichloroacetic acid (TCA) as fixative for anti-pMRLC, anti-Vangl1, anti-Vangl2 and anti-ZO-1 immunostaining.

description: Fixing, blocking, and incubating dissected epididymides with primary and secondary antibodies, and using fluorescent dyes for visualization.
span_chunk: Dissected epididymides were fixed with 4% PFA in PBS for 2 h at 4°C or for 20 min at 37°C, or with 2% TCA in Ca 2+ - and Mg 2+ -free PBS for 20 min at 4°C, depending on target epitopes. The samples were then blocked by incubation in 10% normal goat serum (NGS) [...] for 3 h at 37°C. The samples were treated with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C, and subsequently incubated with secondary antibodies [...]. We used TRITC-conjugated phalloidin [...] and Hoechst 33342 [...] for the visualization of F-actin and DNA, respectively.

description: Mounting samples with agarose gel, immersing in clearing solutions, and obtaining fluorescence images using a confocal laser-scanning microscope.
span_chunk: We mounted samples with 10 μl of 1% agarose gel on a glass-based dish [...] for stable imaging. Then, the samples were immersed with the BABB solution [...] or CUBIC2 solution for optical clearing [...]. Finally, we obtained 8-bit volumetric fluorescence images using the confocal laser-scanning platform Leica TCS SP8 equipped with the hybrid detector Leica HyD.

description: Culturing surgically excised epididymides on an organ culture insert within a Petri dish filled with culture medium.
span_chunk: The epididymides were surgically excised at a region of the vas deferens close to the tail of epididymis, and those with testis were dissected from the embryonic body. Samples were then placed on a hydrophilic polytetrafluoroethylene organ culture insert with a pore size of 0.4 μm [...] filled with a culture medium.

description: Performing live imaging of organ culture using an incubator-integrated multiphoton fluorescence microscope.
span_chunk: Live imaging The organ culture conditions were as described above with the following two minor modifications. First, we used a 35 mm glass-based dish [...] with 700 μl of the culture medium in the dish.
