Second, we adhered each supporting leg of the organ culture insert on the dish with 20 μl of 1% agarose gel. [...] We used an incubator-integrated multiphoton fluorescence microscope (Olympus) using a ×25 water-immersion lens.

description: Performing a tissue compression assay using a manual stretch/compression device and PDMS chamber.
span_chunk: For the tissue compression assay, we used a manual stretch/compression device (STREX, STB-10) with a polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) chamber (STREX, STB-CH-04), and carried out the following steps. First, we exposed the PDMS chamber to plasma arc for 1 min [...] for hydrophilic treatment to enhance the adhesion between the chamber and collagen gel into which the epididymides were embedded.

task_name: Total protein extraction and western blotting
description: Extracting total protein from epididymides, performing SDS-PAGE, and transferring proteins onto membranes for western blotting.
span_chunk: For total protein extraction, dissected epididymides were immersed in SDS-free RIPA buffer with protease inhibitor cocktail [...] and were disrupted by an ultrasonic cell disruptor (Microson). [...] The lysates were prepared for SDS-PAGE by adding 2× Laemmli sample buffer [...] and by boiling at 96°C for 5 min.

description: Incubating membranes with primary and secondary antibodies, and detecting protein bands using a western blotting detection reagent.
span_chunk: For immunoblotting, the membranes were incubated with primary antibodies diluted in 0.1% TBS/Tween-20 at 4°C overnight. [...] Finally, protein bands were detected using the Amersham ECL Select Western Blotting Detection Reagent [...], and were scanned with ImageQuant LAS 4000.

description: Performing co-immunolabelling, imaging, and measuring angles to determine cell division orientation.
span_chunk: We first performed co-immunolabelling for γ-tubulin and pHH3 of six different epididymides to detect MTOCs of mitotic cells [...] Next, we obtained volumetric images [...] Third, we manually measured three angles, α1, α2 and α3, for each mitotic cell to define a local coordinate system [...]

task_name: Quantification of apical junction morphology and signal intensity
description: Performing co-immunostaining, imaging, and digital image processing to analyze apical junction morphology and signal intensity.
span_chunk: We performed co-immunostaining for ZO-1 and either pMRLC, F-actin or VANGL of eight different epididymides [...] Then, we separated the images into smaller ones, around 200×200 pixels [...] The digital image processing was performed as follows. First, images for ZO-1 were filtered slice by slice with a 2D median filter [...]

description: Conducting tests with ovalbumin and dextran to assess the antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs under IFN-γ stimulation.
goal: to assess the antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs
span_chunk: even under interferon-γ (IFN-γ) stimulation, iPS-DCregs always maintain a high antigen uptake ability, in fluorescein isothiocyanate uptake tests with both ovalbumin (OVA) and dextran

task_name: Setting up allogeneic mixed lymphocyte reaction
description: Examining the direct antigen-presenting regulatory function of iPS-DCregs by stimulating naive T cells with BM-DCcons and adding B6 BM-DCregs and iPS-DCregs.
goal: to examine the direct antigen-presenting regulatory function of iPS-DCregs
span_chunk: To identify this role, we first set up an allogeneic mixed lymphocyte reaction (MLR) to examine the direct antigen-presenting regulatory function of iPS-DCregs.

description: Investigating the indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs by co-culturing T cells with OVA-pulsed BM-DCcons and adding B6 BM-DCregs and iPS-DCregs.
goal: to investigate the indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs
span_chunk: We next established OVA-specific MLR to investigate the indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs.

description: Assessing in vivo regulatory function by adoptively transferring OT-II or OT-I T cells into mice and injecting OVA-pulsed BM-DCcons with iPS-DCregs.
goal: to test in vivo regulatory function
span_chunk: In addition, we tested in vivo regulatory function using a proliferation lymph node assay (PLNA).

description: Immunizing CBA mice with B6-derived DCs, isolating spleens, and assessing spleen cells by flow cytometry.
goal: to generate Tregs in vivo and lead to Teff suppression
span_chunk: Next, we immunized CBA mice with B6-derived DCs and isolated their spleens 7 days after immunization.

description: Eluting T cells from spleen cells by nylon column and co-culturing them with BM-DCcons for MLR as secondary immunization.
goal: to perform secondary immunization
span_chunk: We then eluted T cells from these SPCs by nylon column and co-cultured them with B6 BM-DCcons or BALB/c BM-DCcons for MLR, which served as the secondary immunization.

description: Injecting different types of DCregs into CBA recipients and assessing the survival of B6 heart allografts.
goal: to assess the potential application of donor-type iPS-DCregs in the prevention of allograft rejection
span_chunk: Herein, we addressed our main aim to assess the potential application of donor-type iPS-DCregs in the prevention of allograft rejection.

description: Evaluating the infiltration of CD8+ BrdU+ T cells in allografts and measuring mRNA expression of Perforin/Granzyme B and other cytokines.
goal: to assess the reduction of CTLs and cytokine expression
span_chunk: The infiltration of CD8+ bromodeoxyuridine+ (BrdU+) T cells in allografts was significantly decreased in the iPS-DCregs pretreatment group compared with the PBS group on POD7, and was further reduced on POD14.

description: Using immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry to measure the increase of Tregs in allografts and spleens from iPS-DCregs-immunized groups.
goal: to demonstrate the key role of Tregs in allograft acceptance
span_chunk: Tregs markedly increased in allografts from the iPS-DCregs-immunized group in both immunohistochemistry and FCM assessments.

task_name: Depleting Tregs with anti-CD25 monoclonal antibody
description: Injecting anti-CD25 monoclonal antibody into recipients to deplete Tregs and observing the effect on allograft acceptance.
goal: to deplete Tregs and observe the effect on allograft acceptance
span_chunk: First, recipients were treated with iPS-DCregs at 1 × 10^6 (full dose) 7 days prior to transplantation, then anti-CD25 monoclonal antibody (mAb) (1 mg/mouse) was injected into the peritoneum to deplete Tregs.

task_name: Blocking TGF-β1 with anti-TGF-β1 monoclonal antibody
description: Treating recipients with iPS-DCregs and anti-TGF-β1 mAb to block TGF-β1 and assessing the effect on allograft acceptance.
goal: to block TGF-β1 and assess its role in allograft acceptance
span_chunk: First, recipients were treated with iPS-DCregs at 1 × 10^6 on day −7 and anti-TGF-β1 mAb (400 μg/mouse intraperitoneally) on days −7, −5, −3, and 1 to block TGF-β1 before transplantation.

task_name: Isolation of plasma cells from synovial fluid
description: Plasma cells were obtained from the synovial fluid of a patient with anti-CCP–positive RA, and antibody-secreting cells were isolated using the fluorescent foci method.
span_chunk: Plasma cells were obtained from the synovial fluid of a patient with anti-CCP–positive RA, and antibody-secreting cells were isolated from synovial fluid mononuclear cells using the fluorescent foci method.

task_name: Sorting citrulline-specific B cells by flow cytometry
description: Single citrulline-specific B cells were sorted from the peripheral blood of RA patients using an antigen-tetramer system.
span_chunk: In addition, single citrulline-specific B cells were sorted by flow cytometry from the peripheral blood of other RA patients, using an antigen-tetramer system.

description: Peptide ELISAs were performed to assess binding to citrulline-containing and arginine-containing peptides, with mAbs added to the wells at specific concentrations.
span_chunk: Peptide ELISAs were performed as previously described 20, with some minor modifications. The ELISAs assessed binding to both citrulline-containing and arginine (Arg)–containing peptides... The mAb were added to the wells at a concentration of 5 μg/ml, which was diluted by a factor of 2 down to 0.15 ng/ml.

description: Full-length proteins were coated on plates, incubated with citrullination buffer or control, followed by ACPAs and secondary antibodies, and developed with SeramunBlau fast TMB.
span_chunk: For the full-length protein ELISA, 10 μg/ml of fibrinogen... were diluted in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and coated on Nunc Maxisorp 96-well plates... This was followed by development with SeramunBlau fast TMB...

description: Peptides covering arginine and lysine sites of proteins were synthesized and scanned for reactivity with mAbs using a NimbleGen MS200 Scanner.
span_chunk: Peptides (16 amino acids in length) that covered all arginine and lysine sites of 1,610 extracellular matrix proteins and RA-related proteins... Scanning for citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity with each mAb was performed at a resolution of 2 μm, using a NimbleGen MS200 Scanner.

description: Full-length proteins were solubilized, electrophoresed, blotted to a membrane, incubated with citrullination buffer or control, followed by ACPAs and secondary antibody, and visualized using Amersham Hyperfilm.
span_chunk: For Western blot analyses, full-length proteins... were solubilized in 8 M urea at 1 mg/ml, and 10 μg was electrophoresed on 12.5% sodium dodecyl sulfate–polyacrylamide electrophoresis gels, followed by blotting to a nitrocellulose membrane...

description: The flanking amino acids from each posttranslational residue were analyzed using the WebLogo application to generate consensus sequences.
span_chunk: The 4 flanking amino acids from each posttranslational residue were analyzed using the WebLogo application (http://weblogo.threeplusone.com/), which allowed us to generate the consensus sequences of the surrounding amino acids.

task_name: Statistical analysis of mutations and CDR3 characteristics
description: Differences in the number of mutations and CDR3 characteristics between ACPAs and non-ACPAs were determined using Mann-Whitney nonparametric test.
span_chunk: Differences in the number of mutations and third complementarity-determining region (CDR3) characteristics between ACPAs and non-ACPAs were determined by Mann-Whitney nonparametric test.

task_name: Statistical analysis of in vitro experiments
description: Statistically significant differences for in vitro experiments were calculated using one-way Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn's test for multiple comparisons.
span_chunk: For in vitro experiments, statistically significant differences were calculated using one-way Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn's test for multiple comparisons.

description: The cDNAs encoding various proteins were cloned into pBABED-Puro vectors for constitutive expression.
goal: to achieve constitutive expression of proteins
span_chunk: The cDNAs encoding FLAG-aNSa1 (DU54816), FLAG-VHL-aNSa1 (DU54843), FLAG-aCS3 (DU54817), FLAG-VHL-aCS3 (DU54844), FLAG-aASC (DU54821), FLAG-VHL-aASC (DU54832) and human VHL (DU54023) were designed from published protein sequences and cloned into pBABED-Puro vectors (Cell Biolabs, modified; Dundee-modified version of the original Cell Biolabs pBABE plasmid) for constitutive expression.

description: All DNA constructs were verified by DNA sequencing.
span_chunk: All DNA constructs were verified by DNA sequencing, performed by the DNA Sequencing and Services (MRCPPU, College of Life Sciences, University of Dundee, Scotland) using Applied Biosystems Big-Dye v. 3.1 chemistry on an Applied Biosystems model 3730 automated capillary DNA sequencer.

description: Human and mouse cells were cultured in specific media, supplemented with FBS, l-glutamine, and penicillin/streptomycin, and maintained in a humidified incubator.
span_chunk: Human U2OS osteosarcoma, A549 pulmonary adenocarcinoma cells and mouse J774 monocyte were cultured in Dulbecco's Modified Eagle's Medium (DMEM; Gibco) supplemented with 10% (v/v) fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Hyclone), 2 mM l-glutamine (Lonza), and 1% (v/v) penicillin/streptomycin (Lonza) and maintained at 37°C in a humidified incubator at 5% CO2.

description: Retroviral plasmids were co-transfected with other vectors into 293-FT cells to produce retroviruses, which were then used to infect target cells.
goal: to produce retroviruses for infecting target cells
span_chunk: For retroviral production, pBABED retroviral plasmids (6 µg) encoding appropriate proteins were co-transfected with pCMV-gag-pol (3.2 µg) and pCMV-VSV-G (2.8 µg) in a 10 cm–diameter dish of 70% confluent 293-FT cells.

description: Cells were lysed in a specific buffer, and cell extracts were clarified for protein concentration determination or snap-frozen for storage.
span_chunk: For lysis, cells were washed twice in ice-cold phosphate-buffered saline (PBS), scraped on ice in lysis buffer supplemented with complete protease inhibitors and β-mercaptoethanol. Cell extracts were clarified and either processed immediately or snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen prior to storage at −80°C.

description: The protein concentration was determined using Bradford protein assay reagent.
span_chunk: The protein concentration was determined in a 96-well format using Bradford protein assay reagent (Pierce).

description: Lysates were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 resin, washed, and FLAG-fusion proteins were eluted for further analysis.
span_chunk: For anti-FLAG M2 immunoprecipitation, lysates (typically 1 mg) were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 resin (10 µl) for 16 h overnight at 4°C on a rotating wheel.

description: Protein extracts or IPs were separated by electrophoresis, transferred onto membranes, blocked, incubated with primary and secondary antibodies, and detected using ECL reagent.
span_chunk: Reduced protein extracts (typically 10–20 µg protein unless stated otherwise) or immunoprecipitates (IPs) were separated on 8% SDS-PAGE gels, or NuPAGE 4–12% Bis-Tris protein gels (Invitrogen) by electrophoresis.

description: Cells were harvested, RNA was isolated, cDNA synthesis was performed, and RT-PCR was conducted using specific primers.
span_chunk: Cells were washed in PBS and harvested using standard procedures. RNA was isolated following the manufacturer's guidelines (Qiagen). cDNA synthesis and RT-PCR were performed as described previously.

description: Cells were transfected with siRNA oligonucleotides using Lipofectamine RNAiMAX transfection reagent and lysed at specified time points post-transfection.
span_chunk: Cells were transfected with 20 nM (final) small interfering RNA (siRNA) oligonucleotides using 4 µl Lipofectamine RNAiMAX (Invitrogen) transfection reagent per well in a 6-well cell culture plate, in a final volume of 1 ml Optimem (Gibco).

description: Rooted petunia plantlets were grown in a greenhouse under specific temperature and light conditions.
span_chunk: Plants were grown in the greenhouse under a 25/20°C day/night temperature regime and a 12/12 h light/dark photoperiod, with light period starting at 0800 h.

description: Collected petunia flowers at different developmental stages for dynamic headspace analysis to collect volatiles emitted from detached flowers.
span_chunk: For dynamic headspace analysis (Spitzer-Rimon et al., 2012 ) of different developmental stages, petunia P720 flowers [ranging from 3.5 cm buds to 3 days postanthesis (DPA)] were collected at 1600 h.

description: Collected petunia flowers at anthesis stage and initiated headspace collection at specific intervals for 24 hours to analyze diel floral emissions.
span_chunk: For analysis of diel floral emissions, petunia P720 flowers were collected at anthesis stage and headspace was initiated at 0300 h with 4-h intervals for 24 h.

description: Ground petal tissues in liquid nitrogen and extracted in hexane with an internal standard for determination of free volatile compounds.
span_chunk: To determine the pool sizes of free volatile compounds (aglycones) in the corolla limbs (Spitzer-Rimon et al., 2012 ), petal tissues (150 mg fresh weight from at least three different flowers) were collected, ground in liquid nitrogen and extracted in 800 μl hexane containing 2 μg iso butylbenzene as the internal standard.

description: Ground corolla limb tissue in liquid nitrogen, suspended in methanol/water solution, sonicated, centrifuged, and hydrolyzed to release sugar-bound aroma compounds for extraction.
span_chunk: Glycosylated scent compounds were extracted by grinding corolla limb tissue (150 mg fresh weight from at least three different flowers) in liquid nitrogen, suspending in 1.2 ml 80% MeOH:double-distilled water (DDW) (v/v) and sonicating for 20 min.

description: Performed GC–MS analysis using specific equipment and temperature program to analyze scent compounds in samples.
span_chunk: GC–MS analysis (1 μl sample) was performed using a device composed of a Pal autosampler (CTC Analytic), a TRACE GC 2000 equipped with an Rtx-5SIL mass spectrometer fused-silica capillary column (Restek; i.d. 0.25 μm, 30 m × 0.25 mm) and a TRACE DSQ quadruple mass spectrometer (ThermoFinnigan).

description: Detached petunia flowers were incubated with a stable isotope solution, washed, and limb samples were collected at different time points for analysis.
span_chunk: Petunia flowers (line P720) were collected 1 DPA at 1500 h. Detached corollas were excised 1.5 cm below the limbs and placed in a 150-μl solution containing 30 mM 2 H 5 -Phe stable isotope (98% purity, Cambridge Isotope Laboratories).

description: Performed transient overexpression of AnBGL1 in petunia flowers using Agrobacterium tumefaciens and analyzed glycosylated scent compounds by GC–MS.
span_chunk: Transient overexpression of pBINPLUS carrying CaMV 35S-driven AnBGL1 coding for Aspergillus niger β-glucosidase 1, with or without lytic vacuole-targeting determinants ( AnBGL1vac or AnBGL1cyt , respectively) cloned at the N-terminus (Wei et al., 2004 ), was performed in petunia line P720 flowers as described previously (Spitzer-Rimon et al., 2012 ).

description: Ground tissues in liquid nitrogen, extracted in phosphate buffer, measured total protein level, and quantified enzyme activity using a substrate.
span_chunk: For β-glucosidase activity assay, tissues (300 mg) were ground in liquid nitrogen and extracted in 1.2 ml 50 mM phosphate buffer pH 4.3, containing 10 mM EDTA and 4 mM dithiothreitol.

task_name: Isolation of protoplasts and intact vacuoles
description: Isolated protoplasts from petunia petals, assayed viability, and isolated intact vacuoles using a Ficoll step gradient.
span_chunk: Protoplasts were isolated from petunia petals (line Blue Ray) as described by Faraco et al. ( 2014 ). Intact vacuoles were isolated from protoplasts as described previously (Robert et al., 2007 ) with some modifications.

description: Performed western blot analysis to evaluate vacuole purity and protein expression using specific antibodies and detection methods.
span_chunk: Vacuole purity was evaluated using light microscopy and western blot analysis (see details below).

description: Calculated significance of differences between treatments using Student's t-test.
span_chunk: Significance of differences between treatments were calculated by Student's t-test, * P ≤ 0.05, using the SigmaPlot software v13.0 (SYSTAT).

description: C57BL/6J mice were treated with PLX5622 or control chow for 21 days.
goal: to treat mice with PLX5622 or control chow
span_chunk: Starting at 8 weeks old, C57BL/6J mice were treated with PLX5622 or control chow for 21 days.

description: Mice were anesthetized and irradiated with 1.65 Gy on both sides of the head, accumulating a total dose of 10 Gy over 5 days.
goal: to irradiate mice cranially
span_chunk: Irradiated groups received 1.65 Gy of irradiation on both side of the head to accumulate 3.3 Gy for each fractionated irradiation. Three fractions were delivered every other day over 5 days to accumulate a total dose of 10 Gy.

description: Mice were habituated and tested in an open arena with objects to assess their exploratory behavior, with trials recorded and analyzed.
goal: to assess exploratory behavior in mice
span_chunk: The mice were allowed to explore the open arena for 10 min for two consecutive days. On day 3, two identical objects were placed in the arena and mice were allowed to explore for 5 min. On day 4, one of the objects was replaced by a novel object and mice were allowed to explore for 5 min.

task_name: Performing delayed matching-to-place dry maze test
description: Mice were tested in a modified Barnes maze to measure spatial working memory, with trials recorded and analyzed.
goal: to measure spatial working memory in mice
span_chunk: Delayed matching-to-place (DMP) dry maze test was used to measure special working memory as described by Faizi et al.

description: Mice were tested in an open arena with objects at varying distances to measure hippocampal function, with trials recorded and scored.
goal: to measure hippocampal function in mice
span_chunk: Metric distance test was used to measure hippocampal function as previously described by Goodrich-Hunsaker et al.

description: Mice were euthanized, brains dissociated, and cells stained for flow cytometry to analyze cell populations.
goal: to analyze brain cell populations
span_chunk: The mice used for flow cytometry analysis were euthanized and perfused with ice-cold PBS. The brains were removed and immediately placed into ice-cold HBSS. Brain samples were then dissociated using a Neural Tissue Dissociation Kit (P) (Miltenyi Biotec).

description: Brain hemispheres were stained, sectioned, and imaged to analyze dendritic spine density.
goal: to analyze dendritic spine density
span_chunk: Brain hemispheres stayed in Golgi staining solution for 14 days and were transferred into 30% sucrose in ×1 PBS overnight at 4 °C. The next day, tissues were transferred into fresh 30% sucrose solution, protected from light and stored at 4 °C for at least 2 days.

description: Data from various tests were analyzed using ANOVA, t-tests, and plotted with GraphPad Prism software.
goal: to analyze and interpret experimental data
span_chunk: Results for DMP and metric distance tests were analyzed with ordinary two-way ANOVA with Bonferroni’s test for post hoc comparisons using day and experimental group as independent factors.

description: Viral RNA was extracted from virus culture supernatants or patients' plasma using the QIAamp Viral Min Kit.
goal: to extract viral RNA for subsequent analysis
span_chunk: Viral RNA was extracted from 140 μl virus culture supernatants or patients’ plasma using the QIAamp Viral Min Kit (Qiagen, Germany).

task_name: Construction of Mutant Viral RNA Template
description: Mutant viral RNA templates were constructed using a fast mutagenesis system based on the 3′-UTR region of the DENV-4 genome, followed by sub-cloning into a plasmid vector and in vitro transcription.
goal: to create mutants for the mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP assay
span_chunk: To perform the proof-of-concept experiment of the mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP, a series of mutants that form mismatches with the F3, FIP and BLP primers were constructed using a fast mutagenesis system (TransGen, Beijing, China) based on the 3′-UTR region of the DENV-4 genome.

description: Mutant RNAs were quantified using spectrophotometric absorbance and the copy number was calculated using a specific formula.
goal: to quantify the mutant RNAs for the RT-LAMP assay
span_chunk: Mutant RNAs were obtained through in vitro transcription with T7 RNA polymerase, and quantified using spectrophotometric absorbance at 260 nm (NanoDrop, Technologies Inc.).

description: The novel RT-LAMP assay was established using various enzymes and primers, with the reaction performed at 63°C for 60 minutes.
goal: to establish a mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP system
span_chunk: Bst 2.0 DNA polymerase, WarmStart ® RT and Q5 High-Fidelity DNA polymerase (all from New England Biolabs, Beverly, MA, United States) were used to establish the novel mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP system.

task_name: Sensitivity and Limit of Detection Determination
description: The sensitivity and limit of detection (LOD) of the novel DENV RT-LAMP assay were determined using serial dilutions of RNA from DENV stocks and probit regression analysis.
goal: to determine the sensitivity and LOD of the novel DENV RT-LAMP assay
span_chunk: Ten-fold serial dilution of the RNA from four DENV stocks were used as the standards to determine the sensitivity of the novel DENV RT-LAMP assay.

task_name: Evaluation of RT-LAMP Assay with Clinical Samples
description: The novel RT-LAMP assay was evaluated for pan-serotype detection of DENV using plasma samples from dengue-suspected patients.
goal: to evaluate the performance of the novel RT-LAMP assay
span_chunk: To evaluate the performance of the novel RT-LAMP assay for pan-serotype detection of DENV, 153 plasma samples that were previously collected from dengue-suspected patients.

description: A visual detection method was developed by adding hydroxynaphthol blue or using a colorimetric LAMP master mix to the RT-LAMP reaction mix.
goal: to develop a visual detection method for the RT-LAMP assay
span_chunk: To develop a visual detection method, 120 μM hydroxynaphthol blue (HNB) (Sigma-Aldrich, United States) was added to the novel and the conventional RT-LAMP reaction mix.

description: Isolated mRNAs from adult heads of TBPH-null alleles and wild-type controls.
goal: to analyze differences in gene expression patterns
span_chunk: the mRNAs expressed in adult heads of TBPH-null alleles (tbph Δ23 and tbph Δ142 ) and wild-type controls were isolated

description: Hybridized isolated mRNAs to GeneChip Drosophila Genome 2.0 Arrays.
span_chunk: isolated to hybridize GeneChip Drosophila Genome 2.0 Arrays

task_name: Performing statistical analysis of microarray data
description: Conducted statistical analysis to identify dysregulated transposons in TBPH-minus alleles compared to wild type.
span_chunk: the statistical analysis of these experiments revealed that 12 out of the 79 transposons, present in the microarray, appeared dysregulated in TBPH-minus alleles compared to wild type

description: Used quantitative RT-PCR to independently confirm the modifications described in the microarray.
goal: to confirm the activity of retrotransposons was increased in TBPH-mutant tissues
span_chunk: The modifications described in the microarray were independently confirmed by quantitative RT-PCR (qRT-PCR)

description: Treated TBPH-null flies with nucleoside and non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors to observe effects on locomotive defects.
goal: to test if the activation of RTEs contributed to locomotive phenotypes
span_chunk: we treated TBPH-null flies with different combinations of nucleoside and non-nucleoside revert transcriptase inhibitors (NRTI and NNRTI)

description: Utilized transgenic flies carrying RNAi constructs against gypsy to silence its expression in TBPH-null Drosophila.
goal: to test the role of gypsy in TBPH-null phenotypes
span_chunk: we decided to silence the expression of this element in tbph Δ23 homozygous flies

description: Co-expressed a GFP-IR construct with a GFP reporter in transgenic flies to quantify the efficiency of the RNA silencing machinery.
goal: to test whether the siRNA silencing machinery was affected in TBPH-mutant flies
span_chunk: we took advantage of a previously described methodology based on the co-expression of a GFP-IR construct together with a GFP reporter in transgenic flies

task_name: Quantifying protein levels by western blot
description: Performed western blot to quantify the expression levels of the GFP reporter, reflecting the efficiency of the RNA silencing machinery.
span_chunk: differences in the expression levels of the GFP reporter (quantified by western blot) would reflect the efficiency of the RNA silencing machinery

description: Used qRT-PCR techniques to test the brain levels of the principal constituents of the RISC complex.
goal: to identify the molecular mechanisms behind alterations in TBPH-mutant flies
span_chunk: we utilized qRT-PCR technics to test the brain levels of the principal constituents of the RISC complex

description: Expressed a FLAG-tagged isoform of TBPH in Drosophila neurons and performed pull-down assays to confirm physical interaction with Dcr-2 mRNA.
goal: to understand how TBPH may regulate the levels of Dcr-2 expression
span_chunk: we expressed a FLAG-tagged isoform of TBPH in Drosophila neurons and performed pull-down assays from fly head tissues

task_name: Recovering Dcr-2 expression in TBPH-mutant flies
description: Crossed transgenic flies containing the Dcr-2 gene with TBPH-mutant flies to recover Dcr-2 expression levels.
goal: to test if recovery of Dcr-2 expression levels affects TBPH-null phenotypes
span_chunk: we decided to recover the expression levels of Dcr-2 in TBPH-mutant backgrounds

description: Administered enoxacin to TBPH-minus larvae to observe recovery of locomotive capacities and motoneuron innervation patterns.
goal: to confirm the role of Dcr-2 in TBPH-minus phenotypes
span_chunk: TBPH-minus larvae treated with enoxacin were able to significantly recover their locomotive capacities and motoneuron innervation patterns

description: Polyclonal ACPA IgGs and non-ACPA control IgGs were purified from pooled and non-pooled sera of patients with RA, and polyclonal antiproteinase 3 (PR3) IgGs and non-anti-PR3 control IgGs were purified from the sera of a patient with PR3-associated vasculitis.
span_chunk: Polyclonal ACPA IgGs (anti-CCP2 antibodies) and non-ACPA control IgGs were purified from a pooled serum of patients with RA... Using a similar method, polyclonal antiproteinase 3 (PR3) IgGs and non-anti-PR3 control IgGs were purified from the sera of a patient with PR3-associated vasculitis.

task_name: Isolation and expression of monoclonal antibodies
description: Monoclonal antibodies were isolated from patients with RA and recombinantly expressed as IgG1.
span_chunk: Monoclonal antibodies were isolated from patients with RA as previously described 2 4 15 and recombinantly expressed as IgG1.

description: All IgG underwent extensive quality control testing including specificity evaluation, size exclusion chromatography aggregation test, and limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL) endotoxin test.
span_chunk: All IgG underwent extensive quality control testing including specificity evaluation, size exclusion chromatography aggregation test and limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL) endotoxin test.

description: F(ab')2 antibody fragments were generated for use in experiments.
span_chunk: F(ab')2 antibody fragments were generated and RF IgM antibody was purchased from Athens Research & Technology (Georgia, USA).

description: RA-derived and OA-derived synovial fibroblasts as well as human dermal fibroblasts were used in cell culture experiments.
span_chunk: RA-derived and osteoarthritis (OA)-derived synovial fibroblasts as well as human dermal fibroblasts were used in cell culture experiments.

description: Fibroblast migration was assessed by IncuCyte Zoom live cell imaging system or by scratch assay, and adhesion assays were performed using 16-well E-plates and the xCELLigence System Real-Time Cell Analyzer.
span_chunk: Fibroblast migration was assessed by IncuCyte Zoom live cell imaging system or by scratch assay. Adhesion assays were performed using 16-well E-plates and the xCELLigence System Real-Time Cell Analyzer.

description: PI3K was inhibited by wortmanin, PTEN by SF-1670, PAD activity by Cl-amidine or GSK199, and histone acetyltransferase or deacetylase enzymes by anacardic acid or trichostatin A, respectively.
span_chunk: Phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) was inhibited by wortmanin and phosphatase and tensin homolog (PTEN) by SF-1670... PAD activity was inhibited by Cl-amidine or GSK199... Histone acetyltransferase or deacetylase enzymes were inhibited by anacardic acid or trichostatin A.

description: Cytokine levels were analysed using the Cytometric Bead Array and matrix metalloproteinases were measured by ELISA.
span_chunk: Cytokine levels were analysed using the Cytometric Bead Array (BD Biosciences, San Diego, California, USA) and matrix metalloproteinases were measured by ELISA (R&D Systems, Abingdon, UK).

description: FLS were stained with primary antibodies followed by HRP-conjugated antibodies and developed by Vectastain Elite ABC and DAB, then counterstained with Mayer’s haematoxylin for immunohistochemistry. For confocal microscopy, cells and tissues were incubated with primary and secondary antibodies and counterstained with DAPI.
span_chunk: FLS were stained with indicated primary antibodies followed by horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-conjugated antibodies and developed by Vectastain Elite ABC and DAB... For confocal microscopy, cells and tissues incubated with primary and secondary antibodies and then counterstained with 4,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole.

description: Starved and non-starved FLS whole cell lysate were analysed by mass spectrometry for detection of citrullination.
goal: to detect citrullination
span_chunk: Starved and non-starved FLS whole cell lysate were analysed by mass spectrometry for detection of citrullination.

description: Cells lysates were loaded on an SDS-PAGE gel, transferred to nitrocellulose membranes, and incubated with primary and peroxidase-conjugated secondary antibodies.
span_chunk: Cells lysates were loaded an SDS-PAGE gel (Bio-Rad, Solna, Sweden), transferred to nitrocellulose membranes and incubated with primary antibodies and peroxidase-conjugated secondary antibodies.

description: Cells were collected using non-enzymatic detachment reagent, stained by fluorochrome-labelled antibodies, and analysed by FACSVerse flow cytometer.
span_chunk: Cells were collected using non-enzymatic detachment reagent (Sigma-Aldrich, Stockholm, Sweden), stained by fluorochrome-labelled antibodies and analysed by FACSVerse flow cytometer (BD Biosciences, San Jose, California, USA).

description: D. coniospora was cultured at 25°C on solid Nematode Growth Medium (NGM) in the presence of C. elegans or in liquid NGM with Yeast extract (NGMY) in the absence of nematodes.
span_chunk: The D. coniospora strain ATCC 96282 was either cultured at 25°C on solid Nematode Growth Medium (NGM) in the presence of C. elegans, or in liquid NGM with Yeast extract (NGMY) in the absence of nematodes.

description: Fresh spores were inoculated in NGMY medium, cultured for 7 days, harvested by vacuum filtering, dried, ground, and DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Plant Mini Kit.
span_chunk: For the extraction of fungal genomic DNA, roughly 10^9 fresh spores were inoculated in 100 mL NGMY medium. After 7 days culture, mycelia were harvested by vacuum filtering through a sterile 10 μm nylon membrane. The filter was placed in a 30°C incubator for around 3 h, until the mycelia were dry. The mycelia were then manually ground in a liquid nitrogen-cooled mortar. A 20 mg aliquot was transferred to a 1.5 mL tube and the DNA extracted using the DNeasy Plant Mini Kit (Qiagen), following the manufacturer’s instructions.

task_name: Preparation of samples for RNA extraction
description: Fresh spores were collected, inoculated in NGMY liquid medium, cultured, harvested by filtering, flash frozen, and stored at -80°C.
span_chunk: To prepare samples for RNA extraction, fresh spores were first collected from 10 cm NGM plates of infected worms as previously described [114] and inoculated in 100 mL of NGMY liquid medium, and either cultured for 4 days before harvesting, or serially cultured (5 x 8 d cultures). In both cases, samples were collected by filtering cultures through 0.22 μm Steritop units (Milipore), flash frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -80°C.

description: Spores or mycelia were dissolved in Trizol, homogenized, and RNA was purified and cleaned using an RNeasy mini Kit.
span_chunk: Aliquots of 200 mg of spores or mycelia were dissolved in 1 mL Trizol (Invitrogen) in lysing matrix tubes (MP Biomedicals), homogenized for 20 s at 6 m/s in a FastPrep-24 (MP Biomedicals), incubated on ice for 2 min and homogenized a second time. RNA was purified using a standard protocol [115] and cleaned with an RNeasy mini Kit (Qiagen).

description: MIseq paired-end libraries were prepared from genomic DNA and sequenced on an Illumina MIseq sequencer. SOLiD sequencing was performed on mate-paired libraries prepared from genomic DNA.
span_chunk: MIseq paired-end libraries were prepared from genomic DNA and sequenced on an Illumina MIseq sequencer as 2 x 150 bp paired-end reads following the manufacturer’s standard procedures. For SOLiD sequencing, two mate-paired libraries were prepared from D. conisopora genomic DNA following the manufacturer’s instructions.

description: cDNA libraries from mRNA of spores and mycelia were constructed and sequenced using an Illumina HiSeq 2000 platform.
span_chunk: cDNA library construction and Illumina sequencing of mRNA from spores and mycelia using an Illumina HiSeq 2000 platform was performed at the Beijing Genomics Institute.

task_name: De novo genome and transcriptome assembly
description: MIseq reads were processed to filter out contaminants and low quality reads, and used for de novo genome assembly with various software. SOLiD mate-paired reads were used for scaffolding.
span_chunk: MIseq reads were processed with BBDuk software, part of BBMap suite to filter out contaminants and low quality reads. The remaining reads were used for de novo genome assembly with Velvet, SPAdes, SOAPdenovo2 and ABySS using standard input parameters except for ABySS for which k values of 64 and 96 were used. The resulting assemblies were then scaffolded using SOLiD mate-paired reads.

description: A whole genome map of D. coniospora was generated using the Argus Whole-Genome Mapping System and Enzyme Chooser for size-optimized restriction fragments.
span_chunk: A whole genome map of D. coniospora was generated using the Argus Whole-Genome Mapping System. To obtain size-optimized restriction fragments (6–12 kb on average and no fragment larger than 80 kb across the genome) we used Enzyme Chooser that led to the selection of Xba I.

description: Genome annotation was performed using open source software to identify repetitive elements, non-coding RNA, and transposable elements.
span_chunk: Genome annotation was performed using standard open source software. Repetitive elements were mined using RepeatScout version 1.0.5. A specific repeat library was generated in order to mask the genome with RepeatMasker version 4-0-5. TransposonPSI v08222010 was used to characterize different types of transposable elements. Non-coding RNA were identified using Rfam scan perl script v1.0 and tRNAscan-SE v1.3.1 for transfer RNAs.

description: Gene prediction was performed using Augustus trained with D. coniospora transcripts and Fusarium graminearum, followed by annotation with Interproscan.
span_chunk: We performed a first round of gene prediction using Augustus, trained using the Trinity-derived D. coniospora transcripts to predict 8111 protein-coding genes. In a second round, we used Augustus trained using Fusarium graminearum and retained 631 additional predicted proteins. The set of Augustus-predicted protein-coding genes were annotated using Interproscan.

description: Orthologous proteins were identified, aligned, and phylogenetic distances calculated using maximum likelihood-based method within PhyML.
span_chunk: We refined the set of BUSCO-defined orthologues by restricting it to proteins that did not differ by more than 10% in total length across all 12 fungal species. The respective sequences were concatenated were aligned using MAFFT and phylogenetic distances calculated using the maximum likelihood-based method implemented within PhyML.

description: N2 worms were infected with fungal spores, mycelia were collected, protoplasts prepared, and transformed using PEG/CaCl2-mediated DNA uptake.
span_chunk: N2 worms at the L4 stage were infected with fungal spores on NGMY plates spread with the E. coli strain OP50 and incubated for 24 h, then transferred into NGMY liquid medium and cultured for another 30 h. Mycelia were collected by filtration as above and protoplasts prepared and transformed using polyethylene glycol (PEG)/CaCl2-mediated DNA uptake as described.

task_name: Germination and growth of tomato plants
description: Tomato plants were germinated in vermiculite and grown in a growth chamber under specified light, temperature, light intensity, and humidity conditions. Seedlings were irrigated with distilled water and Hoagland solution with or without nitrogen supplements.
span_chunk: Four-week-old tomato plants (Solanum lycopersicum Mill. cv. Ailsa Craig) were germinated in vermiculite in a growth chamber under the following environmental conditions: light/dark cycle of 16/8h, temperature of 24/18 °C, light intensity of 200 μmol m –2 s –1, and relative humidity of 60%. Seeds were irrigated twice a week with distilled water. Seedlings were irrigated for 3 weeks with Hoagland solution (Hoagland and Arnon, 1950) (control plants) or with Hoagland solution lacking N complemented with 20mM KNO3 – (NO3 – plants), or 2, 5, or 8mM NH4 + [(NH4)2SO4] (N-NH4+ plants).

description: Dissolved difluoromethylarginine (DFMA) and difluoromethylornithine (DFMO) in water to create an inhibitor solution, which was then applied to tomato plants.
span_chunk: The chemical PA biosynthesis inhibitors difluoromethylarginine (DFMA) and difluoromethylornithine (DFMO), obtained from Dr Altabella, Centre for Research in Agricultural Genomics (CRAG), were dissolved in water and an inhibitor solution containing 2mM DFMA and 5mM DFMO was produced.

task_name: Treatment with Putrescine and mock solution
description: Applied 0.5mM Putrescine (Put) or mock solution (water) to 4-week-old plants using foliar sprays 48 hours before Pst infection.
span_chunk: For Put treatment, 4-week-old plants were treated with 0.5mM Put or mock solution (water) using foliar sprays applied 48h before Pst infection.

task_name: Pseudomonas syringae and Botrytis cinerea bioassays
description: Grew Pst and B. cinerea, prepared bacterial suspensions, inoculated tomato leaves, and scored disease rate post-inoculation.
span_chunk: Pst was grown in King’s B (KB) medium at 28 °C. ... Pathogen inoculation was performed by dipping the third and fourth leaves into the bacterial suspension. The disease rate was scored at 72h post-inoculation (hpi) by determining the percentage of dark-brown spots on the leaf surface. ... Botrytis cinerea CECT2100 was routinely cultured on potato dextrose agar at 24 °C. The B. cinerea spores were collected from 10- to 15-day-old cultures with sterile water containing 0.01% (v/v) Tween-20, which was then filtered, quantified with a haemacytometer, and adjusted at 1×10 6 ml –1.

task_name: Determination of biomass and chlorophyll content
description: Collected and dried tomato plants, weighed dry tissues for biomass, and measured chlorophyll levels using a chlorophyll meter.
span_chunk: Four-week-old tomato plants (control and N-NH4+ plants) were collected and dried in an oven during 2 d at 65 ºC. Dried plant tissues were weighed, and the dry weight (DW) of 10 plants was obtained and expressed as biomass. The chlorophyll level of the leaves of 4-week-old tomato plants was measured using a chlorophyll meter (SPDA; Minolta, Tokyo, Japan).

description: Used a portable infrared gas analyser to measure the net photosynthetic rate (A N) on mature leaves of tomato plants.
span_chunk: For the net photosynthetic rate (A N) an LCpro+ portable infrared gas analyser (ADC BioScientific Ltd., Hoddesdon, UK) was utilized under ambient CO2 and humidity.

description: Performed DAB staining, destaining, and quantification of staining intensities, and measured H2O2 accumulation using the xylenol orange method.
span_chunk: Samples of 10 leaves were collected for 3′,3-diaminobenzidine (DAB) staining at 3, 24. and 48 hpi. ... H2O2 accumulation in leaves was quantified using the xylenol orange method.

task_name: Analysis of gene expression by qRT-PCR
description: Extracted RNA from leaf tissue, performed reverse transcription, and conducted quantitative real-time PCR to analyze gene expression levels.
span_chunk: Gene expression analysis by qRT-PCR was performed using RNA samples extracted from leaf tissue using the E.Z.N.A. ® Plant RNA Kit, according to the manufacturer’s instructions. ... Quantitative PCR was carried out using the Smart Cycler II instrument (Cepheid).

description: Collected leaves for stomatal aperture analysis, created a cast with nail polish, and measured stomatal apertures using light microscopy and imaging software.
span_chunk: The third and fourth leaves were inoculated with Pst collected from the plants at 1 and 3 hpi, and placed on glass slides with the adaxial epidermis in contact with dental resin. The dental resin mould was filled with nail polish to create a cast that was examined by light microscopy.

task_name: Chromatographic analysis of hormones and PAs
description: Homogenized fresh plant tissue, added internal standards, and injected aliquots into an HPLC system interfaced with a mass spectrometer for hormonal and PA analysis.
span_chunk: For hormonal analysis, fresh material was frozen in liquid N, ground, and freeze dried. ... Analyses of hormone and PA samples were carried out using a Waters Alliance 2690 HPLC system with a nucleosil ODS reversed-phase column.

description: Performed one-way analysis of variance using Statgraphics-plus software and compared means using Fisher’s least-significant difference test.
span_chunk: Statistical analysis was carried out using a one-way analysis of variance in the Statgraphics-plus software of Windows V.5 (Statistical Graphics Corp., Rockville, MD, USA).

description: C57BL/6 mice were treated with 3% DSS in drinking water for 7 days.
goal: to induce colitis in mice
span_chunk: The DSS treatment on mice were carried out in C57BL/6 mice (8 wk, 18–22 g) obtained from Jackson Laboratories (Bar Harbor, ME). DSS [40,000 Da, 3% (wt/vol), ICN Biochemicals, Aurora, OH] was diluted at 3% in drinking water. After 7 days under DSS treatment, the mice were sacrificed by CO2 euthanasia.

description: Total RNA was isolated from 50 mg of proximal colon using TRIzol reagent.
goal: to obtain RNA for further analysis
span_chunk: A small piece (50 mg) of proximal colon was taken for RNA extraction. Total RNA was isolated from colonic tissues using TRIzol (Life Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

task_name: RNA purification via lithium chloride precipitation
description: RNA samples were purified from polysaccharides including DSS by lithium chloride precipitation and centrifugation.
goal: to purify RNA samples
span_chunk: In order to be purified from all polysaccharides including DSS, a purification using lithium chloride was performed.

description: The integrity of the RNA was assessed by 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.
goal: to verify the quality of RNA
span_chunk: The RNA integrity was assessed by 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.

description: cDNA was synthesized from the extracted RNA using the Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit.
goal: to create cDNA for qPCR
span_chunk: cDNA were synthesized using the Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

description: Expression of total RNA was quantified by qPCR using specific primers for 36B4.
goal: to quantify RNA expression levels
span_chunk: Expression of the total RNA was quantified by qPCR using Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix (Thermo Scientific) in a Realplex Thermal Cycler (Eppendorf, Hauppauge, NY).

description: The activity of recombinant Taq DNA polymerase was measured in the presence of DSS using a fluorometric assay.
goal: to measure the effect of DSS on polymerase activity
span_chunk: The polymerase enzymatic activity was measured using the EvaEZ™ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit (Biotium, Hayward, CA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

description: The activity of M-MuLV RT was measured in the presence of DSS using a fluorometric assay.
goal: to measure the effect of DSS on reverse transcriptase activity
span_chunk: The reverse transcriptase enzymatic activity was measured using the EnzChek Reverse Transcriptase Assay kit (Life Technologies, Carlsbad, CA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

description: SPR was used to measure the interaction between primed RNA and reverse transcriptase on a gold sensor chip.
goal: to assess binding affinity between RNA and reverse transcriptase
span_chunk: For SPR experiments, gold sensor chips were used (Biosensing Instrument, Tempe, AZ, USA).

description: Data were analyzed using an unpaired two-tailed t-test to determine statistical significance.
goal: to analyze experimental data for significance
span_chunk: Statistical analysis was performed using an unpaired two-tailed t-test by GraphPad Prism 5 software.

description: Blood samples were collected from patients who met the World Health Organization criteria for a probable case of SARS.
span_chunk: A total of 166 blood samples were obtained from 41 patients [...] who were admitted to the Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong, from March to May 2003.

description: Blood samples from some patients were tested for SARS-CoV using reverse transcription–polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR).
span_chunk: Samples from 7 of the 41 patients were tested for SARS-CoV by reverse transcription–polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) [...].

task_name: Constructing plasmids and culturing cell lines
description: Plasmids were constructed and cell lines were cultured in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium with supplements.
span_chunk: Construction of the plasmid pCAGGS-S harboring full-length SARS-CoV S [...] All cell lines were cultured in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) with Glutamax and high glucose [...].

description: The ACE2 gene was cloned and subcloned into pcdna3.1+, and QT6 cells were transfected and selected to create a bulk ACE2-positive, G418-resistant population.
span_chunk: To make the quail QT6/ACE2 cell line, the gene encoding the receptor for SARS-CoV, human angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) [...] was cloned [...] and subcloned into pcdna3.1+. QT6 cells were transfected by using lipofectamine 2000 and selected with G418 [...].

task_name: Producing viral vectors and infecting target cells
description: 293T cells were transfected with constructs, supernatant was harvested, filtered, and stored. Vector titer was measured on different cell lines using FACS.
span_chunk: Confluent plates of 293T cells were split 1:4 the day before transfection. Each plate of 293T cells was transfected with 1 μg gag/pol construct, 1.5 μg of enhanced GFP reporter construct, and 1.5 μg envelope-expressing construct [...]. Supernatant was harvested 48 h and 72 h posttransfection, filtered through 0.45-μm filters, and stored at –80 o C.

description: Patient serum samples were heat inactivated, diluted, and incubated with SARS virus and Vero E6 cells. Neutralization was assessed by cytopathic effect.
span_chunk: Live Virus Patient serum samples were heat inactivated at 56°C for 30 min and serially diluted from 1:10 in culture medium. Fifty PFU of SARS Frankfurt strain were added to the serum dilution and incubated for 1 h at 37°C. [...] Neutralization was assessed by cytopathic effect (CPE).

description: Patient serum samples were heat inactivated, diluted, and mixed with MLV(SARS) virions. After incubation, GFP-positive cells were counted by fluorescence microscopy.
span_chunk: Pseudotype Patient serum samples were heat inactivated at 56°C for 30 min, 2-fold serially diluted from 1:10 in culture medium, and mixed with MLV(SARS) virions [...]. GFP-positive cells were counted 48 h later by fluorescence microscopy.

description: A construct for expressing HaRxL62 in planta was generated by recombining the ORF from the signal peptide cleavage site cloned into a Gateway destination binary vector under the control of a promoter.
span_chunk: A construct for expressing HaRxL62 in planta was generated by recombining the corresponding ORF from the signal peptide cleavage site cloned in pENTR/SD/D-TOPO (Invitrogen) into the Gateway destination binary vector pENS-StrepII-3×HA-GW under the control of Cauliflower mosaic virus 35S promoter.

description: The HaRxL62 expression construct was transferred to Agrobacterium tumefaciens and used to transform Arabidopsis accession Col-0 by the floral dipping method.
span_chunk: The construct was transferred to Agrobacterium tumefaciens strain GV3101 (pMP90 RK) and transformed into Arabidopsis accession Col-0 by the floral dipping method.

description: Primary transformants were selected on soil containing BASTA and checked for expression of HaRxL62 by Western blot analysis.
span_chunk: Primary transformants (T1) were selected on soil containing BASTA (Bayer CropScience, Wolfenbüttel, Germany) and checked for expression of HaRxL62 by Western blot analysis.

description: Homozygous lines were selected by examining the BASTA resistance of T3 seedlings.
span_chunk: Homozygous lines were selected by examining the BASTA resistance of T3 seedlings.

description: Arabidopsis plants were grown under specific temperature, humidity, and photoperiod conditions in environmentally controlled growth cabinets for Hpa-inoculation assay and SA-induced PR1 expression analysis.
span_chunk: For Hpa -inoculation assay, Arabidopsis plants were grown at 22°C and 60% humidity under a 10-h photoperiod and a 14-h dark period in environmentally controlled growth cabinets. For SA-induced PR1 expression analysis, Arabidopsis plants were grown on 0.7% agar plates of MS medium at 22°C under a 16-h photoperiod and an 8-h dark period in environmentally controlled growth cabinets.

description: Arabidopsis plants were spray-inoculated with a spore suspension of Hpa, covered with a lid to maintain high humidity, and sampled at a specified time for further analysis.
span_chunk: For Hpa infection, Arabidopsis plants were spray-inoculated to saturation with a spore suspension of 5×10 4 conidiospores/ml. Plants were covered with a transparent lid to maintain high humidity (90–100%) conditions in a growth cabinet at 16°C under a 10-h photoperiod until the day for sampling.

description: Total RNAs were extracted, treated with DNaseI, and purified. cDNAs were synthesized from the total RNAs using reverse transcriptase.
span_chunk: Total RNAs were extracted using TRI reagent (Sigma) and 1-bromo-3-chloropropane (Sigma) according to the procedure of the manufacturer. RNAs were precipitated with half volume of isopropanol and half volume of high salt precipitation buffer. RNA samples were treated with DNaseI (Roche) and purified by RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen). Total RNAs (3 µg) were used for generating cDNAs in a 20 µl volume reaction according to Invitrogen Superscript II Reverse Transcriptase protocol.

description: qRT-PCR was performed using SYBR Green mix, diluted cDNAs, and specific primers to determine the relative expression values of genes.
span_chunk: qPCR was performed in 10 µl final volume using 5 µl SYBR Green mix (Sigma), 1 µl diluted cDNAs, and primers. The relative expression values were determined using EF-1α (At5g60390) as a reference gene and the comparative cycle threshold method (2 −ΔΔCt).

description: Genomic DNA was extracted from Hpa Waco9 conidiospores and sequenced on Illumina Genome Analyzer II.
span_chunk: Genomic DNA was extracted from Hpa Waco9 conidiospores using a Nucleon PhytoPure DNA extraction kit (GE Healthcare). A paired-end 400 bp insert size library was prepared and sequenced on Illumina Genome Analyzer II.

task_name: RNA sequencing and differential expression analysis
description: RNA sequencing was performed on purified double stranded cDNAs, and differential expression analysis was conducted using the R statistical language with the Bioconductor package edgeR.
span_chunk: RNA sequencing was performed as described previously [33]. Differential expression analysis was performed using the R statistical language version 2.11.1 with the Bioconductor [81] package, edgeR version 1.6.15 [82] with the exact negative binomial test using tagwise dispersions.

description: DNA sequences upstream of the start codon of coexpressed Hpa genes were extracted and analyzed for cis-regulatory elements using MEME, FIMO, and TOMTOM.
span_chunk: For identifying cis-regulatory elements, 200 and 500 nt upstream of the start codon of coexpressed Hpa genes categorized into five groups as shown in Figure 2B and Table S3 were extracted from Waco9-SNVs-corrected v8.3 genome sequence using a custom Perl script.

description: Gene ontologies in Arabidopsis genes were analyzed for enrichment using AgriGO with a specified false discovery rate.
span_chunk: To investigate enrichment of specific gene ontologies in Arabidopsis genes categorized into four groups (Group I to IV) as shown in Figure 4D and Table S7, the Singular Enrichment Analysis was done with FDR = 0.05 using AgriGO.

description: Neural stem cells, Cor3–1 and P19 cells, were grown and maintained in specified complete media with supplements and conditions as described.
span_chunk: Neural stem cells, Cor3–1 were grown in Complete media... P19 cells were maintained in MEM-α (Gibco, 41061-029) supplemented with 10% FBS and 100 units/ml penicillin and 100 μg/ml streptomycin.

description: Cells were transferred into priming and differentiation media with specific supplements to induce neuronal differentiation, with changes in medium composition over time.
span_chunk: For neuronal differentiation, 24 hours after seeding, cells were transferred into a priming medium... Cells were then transferred into a differentiation medium... followed by a change of medium every 3 days with reduction of the FGF concentration by half to zero and a constant concentration of BDNF at 30 ng/ml.

description: P19 cells were transfected with Lipofectamine 2000 and plasmids at 80% confluence, following the manufacturer's instructions.
span_chunk: P19 cells were transfected at 80% confluence with Lipofectamine 2000 (Invitrogen, 11668-027) in proliferation medium following the manufacturer’s instructions with a 1:2 ratio (DNA:Lipofectamine).

description: Total RNA was extracted, cDNA synthesized, and qRT-PCR performed to measure gene expression levels, with data normalized to a housekeeping gene.
span_chunk: Total RNA was extracted from cells using the RNeasy kit (Qiagen). Template cDNAs were synthesised using the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit (Qiagen), and qRT-PCR was performed using QuantiFast SYBR Green Master Mix (Qiagen) in a Lightcycler 480 PCR system (Roche).

description: Proteins were extracted from total or fractionated cell lysates, quantified, separated by SDS-PAGE, transferred to membranes, and probed with specific antibodies for detection.
span_chunk: Western blots were either performed from total cell lysates obtained by lysing cells directly with RIPA buffer... Proteins concentration was determined using BCA protein assay kit... After transfer onto nitrocellulose, membranes were blocked... and probed overnight with primary antibody... Membranes were developed using ECL Prime... for Ascl1 or ECL detection reagents... for the other antibodies.

description: Cells were fractionated into cytoplasmic, nuclear, and chromatin fractions using a series of buffers and centrifugation steps, followed by protein concentration determination.
span_chunk: Cells were washed once with room temperature PBS and scraped into 1 ml PBS... The supernatant was collected in a fresh tube (cytoplasm fraction)... The supernatant was collected in a fresh tube (nucleus fraction)... The solution (chromatin fraction) was sonicated... All fractions were centrifuged at 13,000 rpm at 4 °C for 10 min and protein concentration was determined using BCA protein assay kit.

description: Ubiquitylated proteins were pulled down from cytoplasm and chromatin fractions using Agarose-TUBEs, followed by washing and boiling for sample preparation.
span_chunk: Agarose-TUBEs pull down 15 μl of 50% Agarose-TUBEs (LifeSensors, UM401) were used to pull down between 350 μg and 450 μg of ubiquitylated proteins from the cytoplasm and chromatin fractions... Agarose-TUBEs were washed 3 times following the manufacturer’s instructions and were boiled in reducing sample buffer... for 5 min, centrifuged at maximum speed in a top bench centrifuge for 1 min and eluted samples were loaded onto gels.

description: Cells were treated with cycloheximide, harvested at defined time points, and lysates were analyzed by western blot to determine protein half-lives.
span_chunk: Cor3-1 cells or transfected P19 cells... were treated with 10 μg/ml cycloheximide... At define time points, cells were harvested... Equal amount of each whole cell lysate or fractionated lysate was separated on SDS-PAGE and immmunoblotted... Protein levels were quantified with FiJi software. Half-lives were calculated using a nonlinear regression analysis (One phase decay, Prism).

description: Cells were fixed, permeabilized, blocked, and incubated with primary and secondary antibodies, followed by DAPI staining and fluorescence visualization.
span_chunk: At indicated time, cells were fixed in 4% paraformaldehyde... Cells were then washed twice in PBS and permeabilised... Blocking was performed... Anti-Ascl1 primary antibody... was used... The next day, cells were washed 3 times... and incubate with secondary antibody... Cells were next washed 3 times... and incubated in 4′,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole (DAPI)... After 2 washes in PBS, fluorescence labelling was visualised with Axio Scan (Zeiss).

description: P19 cells were transfected with reporter plasmids, harvested at specific time points, and analyzed using a dual-luciferase reporter assay system.
span_chunk: P19 cells were plated into 48-well plates... and transfected the day after with 100 ng ΔM short-Luciferase... One set of cells was harvested the day after... with the Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay System... while the other set of cells was transferred into differentiation media and harvested 24 hours later. Luciferase assay was performed following the manufacturer’s instructions... Values for Luciferase were normalised to Renilla-Luciferase values and data are presented as means ± SEM of duplicate and experiments were repeated three times.

description: Male albino Wistar rats were housed under controlled conditions and anaesthetized for surgery using chloral hydrate. They were then positioned in a stereotaxic apparatus for injections into the substantia nigra (SN).
span_chunk: Male albino Wistar rats (250 to 270 g) were used for these studies. The rats were kept at constant room temperature of 22°C ± 1°C and 60% relative humidity on a 12:12-hour light–dark cycle with free access to food and water. Rats were anaesthetized with chloral hydrate (400 mg/kg) and positioned in a stereotaxic apparatus.

description: Rats received intranigral injections of various substances and were subjected to a chronic variate stress model over 9 days, with stressed and nonstressed groups.
span_chunk: Injections into the SN were made 5.5 mm posterior, 1.8 mm lateral and 8.3 mm ventral to the bregma at day 1, 2 hours after the application of the first stressor. Five groups of animals were established according to the different treatments.

description: All animals were euthanized by decapitation or perfusion at specified times post-surgery for subsequent RT-PCR or immunohistochemistry experiments.
span_chunk: All animals were killed by decapitation at 6 hours after surgery (RT-PCR experiments) or by perfusion 10 days after surgery (immunohistochemistry experiments).

description: Blood was collected from deeply anaesthetized rats, and serum corticosterone concentration was measured using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.
goal: to measure serum corticosterone concentration
span_chunk: Serum corticosterone concentration was measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

description: Coronal sections were cut, mounted, and stained with primary antibodies followed by biotinylated secondary antibodies and visualized using a peroxidase reaction.
span_chunk: Thaw-mounted 20-μm coronal sections were cut on a cryostat at -15°C and mounted on gelatine-coated slides. Sections were washed and then treated with 0.3% hydrogen peroxide in methanol for 20 minutes, washed again, and incubated with primary antibodies followed by biotinylated secondary antibodies and ExtrAvidin–Peroxidase.

description: Analysis of immunohistochemical data was performed using imaging software to measure areas lacking GFAP immunoreactivity and to count cells showing OX-6 immunoreactivity.
span_chunk: For the measurement of areas lacking GFAP immunoreactivity, we used analySIS imaging software coupled to a Polaroid DMC camera attached to a Leica light microscope. To count cells showing OX-6 immunoreactivity, we systematically sampled the area occupied by the OX-6-positive cells in each section.

description: Sections were blocked, incubated with primary antibodies, followed by fluorescently labeled secondary antibodies, and nuclei were counterstained with Hoechst dye.
span_chunk: For double-labelling of Iba-1 with TH, sections were blocked with PBS containing 1% normal horse serum for Iba-1 and 1% goat serum for TH for 1 hour. The slides were washed three times in PBS, then incubated overnight at 4°C with primary antibodies followed by secondary antibodies.

description: Total RNA was extracted from the substantia nigra, cDNA synthesized, and real-time PCR performed to quantify gene expression levels.
goal: to quantify gene expression levels
span_chunk: Total RNA was extracted from the SN using the RNeasy kit. cDNA was synthesized from 1 μg of total RNA using the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit. Real-time PCR was performed with iQ SYBR Green Supermix, primers, and cDNA.

description: Protein samples from the substantia nigra were separated by SDS-PAGE, transferred to a membrane, and probed with specific antibodies.
span_chunk: Protein samples were separated by SDS-PAGE (10%) and transferred onto a nitrocellulose membrane. Membranes were blocked and then incubated using specific antibodies.

description: Lipid peroxidation was measured using a microplate reader by incubating samples with FOX reagent and detecting the formation of ferric ions.
goal: to measure lipid peroxidation
span_chunk: The protocol for lipid peroxidation measurements was adapted for a microplate reader. Sample buffer was incubated with FOX reagent, and the formation of ferric ions was detected by measuring the resulting coloured complex formed by xylenol orange at 560 nm.

description: Data were analyzed using Student’s t-test or ANOVA followed by LSD test for post hoc comparisons, with calculations performed using STATGRAPHICS Plus software.
goal: to analyze experimental data
span_chunk: Results are expressed as mean ± SD. Means were compared by using Student’s t-test or analysis of variance (ANOVA) followed by the least significant difference (LSD) test for post hoc multiple range comparisons.

description: Cells were cultured in DMEM + 10% fetal bovine serum at 37°C and 5% CO2, with or without recombinant ribonuclease inhibitor added.
span_chunk: Cells were cultured in DMEM + 10% fetal bovine serum (S+ medium) at 37°C and 5% CO2 or in different serum-free formulations as depicted in SI Materials and Methods.

description: The cell-conditioned medium was ultracentrifuged, and the supernatant was concentrated and subjected to size-exclusion chromatography or RNA extraction.
span_chunk: The cell-condtioned medium already spinned at 2000 × g was centrifuged for 2.5 h at 100 000 × g and 4°C in a Beckman Coulter Optima XPN-90 ultracentrifuge using a SW40 Ti rotor.

description: Concentrated EV-depleted fractions were injected into a column, and SEC was performed to collect fractions while monitoring absorbance.
span_chunk: Concentrated EV-depleted fractions (500 μl) were injected in a Superdex S200 10/300 column (Amersham, GE) and size exlusion chromatography (SEC) was performed at 0.9 ml/min in 0.22 μm-filtered 1× PBS with an Äkta Pure (GE healthcare) FPLC system.

description: RNA was purified from chromatographic peaks, diluted, and used for NGS library preparation, followed by sequencing.
span_chunk: RNA was purified from selected chromatographic peaks using TRIzol LS and following manufacturer's instructions. The obtained RNA was diluted in 8 μl of ultra-pure RNase-free water, and 7 μl were used as input for NGS library preparation using the NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina (New England Biolabs).

description: Northern blots were performed using digoxigenin-labeled DNA probes and detected with an imaging system.
span_chunk: Northern blots (10% denaturing gels transferred to positively-charged nylon membranes) were performed based on digoxigenin-labeled DNA probes and an alkaline phosphatase-labeled anti-digoxigenin antibody (Roche).

task_name: Differentiation of dendritic cells and flow-cytometry
description: Mouse bone marrow-derived dendritic cells were prepared, treated with chromatographic fractions or synthetic RNAs, and analyzed by flow cytometry.
span_chunk: Adherent mouse bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (BMDC) were prepared as described in ( 26 ). Selected chromatographic fractions or synthetic RNAs were added to 1 × 10 6 BMDCs.

description: Compile a database with protein sequences of 93 vertebrate TDP43 homologs, split into separate collections of NTDs, RRM domains, and CTDs.
span_chunk: Therefore, we turned to evolutionary sequence analysis and compiled a database with protein sequences of 93 vertebrate TDP43 homologs, which we split up into separate collections of NTDs, RRM domains and CTDs.

description: Calculate the number of amino-acid exchanges, additions, or subtractions normalized to a sequence length of 100 amino acids between all members of each category.
span_chunk: As a simple measure of the sequence diversity within these collections, we calculated the number of amino-acid exchanges, additions or subtractions (i.e., the Levenshtein or edit distance) normalized to a sequence length of 100 amino acids between all members of each category.

description: Separately analyze the amino-acid composition of the conserved region (CR) and each of the two intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) that bracket the CR.
span_chunk: This unusual (and complicating) arrangement prompted us to separately analyze the amino-acid composition of the CR and each of the two intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) that bracket the CR.

description: Calculate the hydrophobicity throughout the human TDP43 CTD in a sliding window of five amino acids using fourteen different hydrophobicity scales.
span_chunk: To illustrate this periodic hydrophobic pattern, we calculated the hydrophobicity throughout the human TDP43 CTD in a sliding window of five amino acids using fourteen different hydrophobicity scales.

description: Replace the RNA-binding RRM domains of TDP43 with GFP to generate a reporter protein (TDP43 RRM-GFP) that assembles into micron-sized liquid droplets.
span_chunk: To overcome this barrier, we replaced the RNA-binding RRM domains of TDP43 with GFP to generate a reporter protein (hereafter called TDP43 RRM-GFP) that assembles into micron-sized liquid droplets.

description: Screen a panel of CTD mutants with systematic alterations in the composition and spacing of selected hydrophobic motifs or residues using the TDP43 RRM-GFP reporter assay.
span_chunk: TDP43 RRM-GFP condensates are hence ideally suited for rapid, quantitative analysis of CTD sequence variants in live cells, allowing us to screen a panel of CTD mutants with systematic alterations in the composition and spacing of selected hydrophobic motifs or residues.

description: Combine high-throughput automated confocal microscopy and flow cytometry to monitor nuclear and total GFP fluorescence in cells expressing TDP43 RRM-GFP with wild-type or mutant IDRs.
span_chunk: To estimate changes in Csat caused by IDR mutations, we combined high-throughput automated confocal microscopy and flow cytometry to monitor the nuclear and total GFP fluorescence in thousands of cells expressing TDP43 RRM-GFP with wild-type (WT) or mutant IDRs.

task_name: Purify full-length TDP43 with variant CTDs
description: Purify full-length TDP43 with WT, F-S, or FYW-S variant CTDs from bacteria and investigate their phase separation behavior in vitro.
span_chunk: To corroborate our findings in the context of full-length TDP43 and further validate our TDP43 RRM-GFP reporter assay, we purified full-length TDP43 with WT, F-S or FYW-S variant CTDs from bacteria and investigated their phase separation behavior in vitro.

task_name: Test effect of RNA on phase separation
description: Test the effect of RNA on the phase separation of purified WT and mutant TDP43.
span_chunk: Given that TDP43 is an RNA-binding protein, we next tested the effect of RNA on the phase separation of purified WT and mutant TDP43.

description: Use half-bleach fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (FRAP) experiments to assess the material properties of TDP43 RRM-GFP droplets.
span_chunk: Material properties of the large TDP43 RRM-GFP droplets can be readily assessed using half-bleach FRAP experiments.

task_name: Design mutants to alter hydrophobic clusters
description: Design mutants where the total number of hydrophobic clusters is reduced from eight to six, four, or two by grouping the clusters together.
span_chunk: To test the relative importance of these two parameters, we designed mutants where the total number of clusters was reduced from eight to six, four or two by simply grouping the clusters together.

description: Build a flow cytometry-compatible splicing reporter to co-express a splicing-sensitive fluorescent protein and full-length TDP43 (or variants thereof) from the same transiently transfected plasmid.
span_chunk: To analyze the splicing activity of TDP43 variants rapidly, quantitatively and with single-cell resolution, we built a flow cytometry-compatible splicing reporter, which uses a bidirectional promoter to co-express a splicing-sensitive fluorescent protein and full-length TDP43 (or variants thereof) from the same transiently transfected plasmid.

description: Planarian cell suspensions were stained with Hoechst 33342 (nuclear dye) and MTG (mitochondrial dye) to reveal distinct populations based on nuclear content and mitochondrial mass.
goal: to reveal distinct mitochondrial mass in planarian cell populations
span_chunk: The cell suspension of planaria was stained with Hoechst 33,342 (nuclear dye) and MTG.

description: The distribution of MTG fluorescence was assessed in different cell populations, with X1 cells showing perinuclear and polarized distribution, while Xins cells exhibited even cytoplasmic distribution.
span_chunk: MTG fluorescence in most X1 cells was more perinuclear and exhibited polarized distribution in the cytoplasm. Conversely, MTG fluorescence in Xins cells, in general, was evenly distributed in the cytoplasm.

description: Cells were treated with Verapamil, an efflux pump inhibitor, and stained with MTG to test if the low MTG intensity in X1 and X2 cells was due to dye efflux.
goal: to test whether the low MTG intensity in X1 and X2 cells was a consequence of dye efflux
span_chunk: To test whether the low MTG intensity in X1 and X2 cells was a consequence of dye efflux, the cells were treated with Verapamil, an efflux pump inhibitor, and stained with MTG.

description: An antibody to PIWI-1 was generated and characterized to examine the status of piwi-1 in MTG Low and MTG High cells within the X1 population.
goal: to examine the status of piwi-1 in MTG Low and MTG High cells
span_chunk: To examine the status of piwi-1 in MTG Low and MTG High cells, we first generated and characterized an antibody to PIWI-1.

description: Planarian cells were immunostained for PIWI-1 protein to identify High, Low, and negative PIWI-1 cells among different cell populations.
goal: to identify High, Low, and negative PIWI-1 cells
span_chunk: The immuno-staining with PIWI-1 antibody in planarian cells identified High, Low, and negative PIWI-1 cells.

description: RNA sequencing was performed on X1-MTG Low and X1-MTG High populations to understand the functional states of High and Low MTG cells.
goal: to understand the functional states of High and Low MTG cells
span_chunk: In order to understand the functional states of High and Low MTG cells, RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed on X1-MTG Low and X1-MTG High populations.

task_name: Flow cytometry analysis of PIWI-1 expression
description: Flow cytometry was used to analyze PIWI-1 expression in X2-MTG Low and MTG High cells, and cells were sorted based on size (FSC) to separate PIWI-1 High and Low cells.
goal: to analyze PIWI-1 expression in X2-MTG Low and MTG High cells
span_chunk: Flow cytometry analysis based on the size showed PIWI-1 High cells are large in size compared with the PIWI-1 low cells.

description: RNA-seq analysis was conducted on four populations sorted from X2-MTG Low and MTG High cells to investigate the nature of these cells.
goal: to investigate the nature of cells in X2-MTG Low and MTG High populations
span_chunk: To gain further insights into the nature of the cells in the MTG Low and MTG High populations of X2, we performed RNA-seq on the four populations.

description: Transplantation experiments were conducted by injecting sorted MTG populations into lethally irradiated animals to assess pluripotent stem cell (PSC) activity.
goal: to assess pluripotent stem cell activity in sorted MTG populations
span_chunk: For our transplantation experiments, we used SiR-DNA (Cytoskeleton inc.), a nuclear dye, recently used as an alternative to isolating 4N cells from planarians instead of Hoechst dye, which was shown to be toxic.

task_name: Staining with MTG and MitoTracker Orange
description: Planarian cells were stained with MTG and MitoTracker Orange (MTO) to assess the correlation between mitochondrial content and mitochondrial activity.
goal: to assess the correlation between mitochondrial content and activity
span_chunk: To understand the mitochondrial activity of MTG Low and −High cells, planarian cells were simultaneously stained with MTG and MitoTracker Orange (MTO).

task_name: Treatment of regenerating worms with FCCP
description: Regenerating worms were treated with FCCP, an uncoupler of oxidative phosphorylation, to investigate the effect on stem cell differentiation.
goal: to investigate the effect of FCCP on stem cell differentiation
span_chunk: We treated the regenerating worms with FCCP. We chose low doses of FCCP (30 nM) to treat the regenerating animals.

task_name: Culturing and treating neoblasts with FCCP
description: Neoblasts were cultured and treated with FCCP to perturb mitochondrial activity and assess the maintenance of the pluripotent state.
goal: to perturb mitochondrial activity in stem cells and assess pluripotency
