span_chunk: To specifically perturb the mitochondrial activity in stem cells, we cultured the neoblasts and treated them with FCCP.

description: Screened publicly available datasets for Arabidopsis genes of unknown function that exhibit transcriptional signatures of chlorophyll biosynthesis genes (CBGs) or chlorophyll catabolism genes (CCGs) to identify novel regulators.
goal: to identify novel regulators of Chl biosynthesis and catabolism
span_chunk: To identify novel regulators of Chl biosynthesis and catabolism, we screened publicly available datasets for Arabidopsis genes of unknown function that exhibit the transcriptional signatures of CBGs or CCGs, and identified At 2g35260, hereafter designated BCM1.

description: Performed immunoblot analyses using BCM1 antiserum raised against recombinant Arabidopsis His-BCM155 to determine the accumulation of BCM1 protein in various Arabidopsis tissues.
span_chunk: Immunoblot analyses using a BCM1 antiserum raised against recombinant Arabidopsis His-BCM155 showed that BCM1 accumulates as an ~36 kDa protein in all Arabidopsis tissues except roots.

task_name: Transient expression of BCM1-YFP fusion protein
description: Transiently expressed BCM1 fused to yellow fluorescent protein (YFP) in Arabidopsis protoplasts to determine the chloroplast localization of BCM1.
span_chunk: Transient expression of BCM1 fused to yellow fluorescent protein (YFP) in Arabidopsis protoplasts reveals chloroplast localization for BCM1.

description: Conducted immunoblot analyses of isolated envelope, stroma, and thylakoid fractions of chloroplast to determine the localization of BCM1 within the chloroplast.
span_chunk: Immunoblot analyses of isolated envelope, stroma, and thylakoid fractions of chloroplast showed that ~92% of BCM1 was located in the thylakoid membrane and only ~8% in the envelope fraction.

task_name: Treatment of thylakoids with chaotropic and alkaline reagents
description: Treated isolated thylakoids with chaotropic and alkaline reagents to assess whether BCM1 acts as an integral or peripheral thylakoid protein.
goal: to clarify whether the BCM1 acts as an integral or peripheral thylakoid protein
span_chunk: To clarify whether the BCM1 acts as an integral or peripheral thylakoid protein, isolated thylakoids were treated with chaotropic and alkaline reagents to release membrane-associated proteins.

task_name: Characterization of bcm1 mutants and BCM1-OX plants
description: Characterized the status of tetrapyrrole biosynthesis (TBS) in seedlings of bcm1 mutants and BCM1-overexpressing (BCM1-OX) plants to investigate the function of BCM1 in chlorophyll biosynthesis.
goal: to investigate the function of BCM1 in Chl biosynthesis
span_chunk: To investigate the function of BCM1 in Chl biosynthesis, we characterized the status of TBS in seedlings of bcm1 mutants and BCM1-overexpressing (BCM1-OX) plants.

task_name: Immunoblot analyses of CBGs and CBEs
description: Performed immunoblot analyses to examine the expression of chlorophyll biosynthesis genes (CBGs) and steady-state levels of chlorophyll biosynthesis enzymes (CBEs) in bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings.
span_chunk: To further elucidate the molecular function of BCM1 in Chl biosynthesis, the expression of CBGs and steady-state levels of CBEs were examined in bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings.

task_name: Quantitative real-time PCR analyses of CBGs
description: Conducted quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) analyses to measure the transcript levels of CBGs in bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings.
span_chunk: The quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) analyses showed that transcripts of all CBGs attained WT-like levels in both bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings.

task_name: Yeast two-hybrid and BiFC assays for protein interactions
description: Utilized yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) screening and bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC) assays to detect potential protein-protein interactions involving BCM1 in the TBS pathway.
span_chunk: A yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) screen for potential partners of BCM1 in the TBS pathway detected interactions with GluTR, GUN4, and CHLM. These interactions were confirmed by the bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC) approach.

task_name: In vitro MgCh activity assays with recombinant proteins
description: Explored the effect of BCM1 on magnesium chelatase (MgCh) activity in vitro using recombinant MgCh components and isolated thylakoid membranes.
span_chunk: To determine whether this interaction is necessary for the stimulation of MgCh activity, the effect of BCM1 on MgCh activity was explored in vitro using recombinant MgCh components.

description: Employed virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS) to knock down the expression of BCM2 in wild-type or bcm1-3 plants and assess the phenotypic effects.
span_chunk: Furthermore, the efficient gene silencing of BCM2 was achieved by a virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS) approach in WT or bcm1-3 plants.

task_name: Chlorophyll degradation assays during dark-induced senescence
description: Measured chlorophyll degradation rates in leaves from various Arabidopsis seedlings subjected to dark-induced senescence (DIS) to investigate the function of BCMs in chlorophyll catabolism.
span_chunk: To investigate the potential function of the two Arabidopsis BCM paralogs in Chl catabolism, Chl degradation rates were determined in leaves detached from 5-week-old WT, bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings and subjected to dark-induced senescence (DIS).

task_name: Collecting mRNA levels from TCGA dataset
description: Collecting the mRNA levels of MCU and related proteins from the TCGA breast cancer dataset.
span_chunk: we collected the mRNA levels of MCU and related proteins (MCUb, MICU1‐3, and EMRE) from the TCGA breast cancer dataset

task_name: Data analysis of tumor size and lymph node infiltration
description: Analyzing data relative to tumor size and regional lymph node infiltration to demonstrate correlation with MCU and MCUb expression levels.
span_chunk: Data analyses relative to tumor size and regional lymph node infiltration demonstrate a significant correlation of MCU and MCUb expression levels with breast cancer clinical stages

description: Using short-interfering RNA to inhibit MCU in three different human metastatic TNBC models and measuring the effect on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake.
span_chunk: In all three cell models, short‐interfering RNA (siRNA)‐mediated inhibition of MCU caused a significant decline in agonist‐induced mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake

description: Conducting a wound healing migration assay to monitor the effect of MCU silencing on cell motility in TNBC lines.
span_chunk: MCU silencing impaired cell motility, monitored by wound healing migration assay, in all TNBC lines tested

task_name: Measurement of cytosolic Ca2+ transients and SOCE
description: Measuring cytosolic Ca2+ transients, SOCE, and ER Ca2+ content to determine the effects of MCU silencing on global cellular Ca2+ signaling.
span_chunk: To clarify whether the impairment of migration is specifically due to the reduction in mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake, or rather to indirect effects of MCU silencing on global cellular Ca2+ signaling, cytosolic Ca2+ transients, SOCE, and ER Ca2+ content were measured.

description: Performing an in vitro spheroid formation assay to investigate the invasion potential of TNBC cells upon MCU silencing.
span_chunk: For this purpose, an in vitro spheroid formation assay was performed.

description: Using CRISPR/Cas9 Nuclease RNA-guided genome editing technology to delete MCU in MDA-MB-231 cells and testing the effect on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake.
span_chunk: MCU deletion of MDA-MB-231 cells was achieved by CRISPR/Cas9 Nuclease RNA-guided genome editing technology.

task_name: Orthotopic tumor analysis in SCID mice
description: Injecting MCU −/− MDA-MB-231 cells into the fat pad of SCID mice and measuring tumor growth, lymph node infiltration, and metastasis formation.
span_chunk: MCU −/− cells were injected into the fat pad of SCID mice, and tumor size, lymph node infiltration, and metastasis formation were measured.

task_name: Measurement of cellular NADH levels and ATP production
description: Measuring cellular and mitochondrial NADH levels, NADPH levels, and ATP production using live cell fluorescent and luminescent techniques.
span_chunk: To understand the impact of MCU downregulation on mitochondrial redox metabolism, we measured cellular and mitochondrial NADH levels, NADPH levels, and ATP production using live cell fluorescent and luminescent techniques.

description: Measuring mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide levels and superoxide anion levels to assess the effect of MCU silencing on mitochondrial ROS production.
span_chunk: Next, we sought to verify the role of mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake in ROS production. For this purpose, we directly measured mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) levels with pHyper-dMito protein sensor.

task_name: Analysis of HIF-1α protein levels and transcription
description: Investigating the effect of MCU silencing on HIF-1α protein levels and transcription, including the use of proteasome inhibitor and paraquat treatment.
span_chunk: Given the observed decrease in mROS production by MCU silencing, we asked whether MCU regulates HIF-1α levels, either controlling protein stability or gene transcription.

description: Re-expressing HIF-1α in MCU-silenced cells to determine if it rescues the impairment of migration caused by MCU silencing.
span_chunk: To verify whether HIF-1α determines shMCU-mediated effects on cell migration, we carried out a rescue experiments by re-expressing HIF-1α in MCU-silenced cells.

description: Breeding Tlr7 -/- Tlr9 -/- double knockout mice in house and confirming their C57BL/6 background by microsatellite genotyping.
span_chunk: Tlr7 -/- Tlr9 -/- double knockout mice were bred in house. All strains were confirmed to have a C57BL/6 background of greater than 95% by microsatellite genotyping.

task_name: Maintaining P. berghei strain ANKA parasites
description: Using P. berghei strain ANKA parasites maintained in C57BL/6 mice for experiments.
span_chunk: All experiments were performed using P. berghei strain ANKA (MRA-311) parasites, which were obtained from the MR4 stock centre and maintained in C57BL/6 mice.

description: Introducing infected erythrocytes into new mice by intraperitoneal injection to initiate infections.
span_chunk: Blood was harvested by cardiac puncture from an infected mouse on day 5 of infection, and 10 6 infected erythrocytes were introduced into a new mouse by intraperitoneal injection in 100 μl of Alsever’s solution.

task_name: Monitoring survival and cerebral malaria symptoms
description: Daily monitoring of survival and signs of cerebral malaria, with increased frequency during peak lethality.
span_chunk: Survival and signs of cerebral malaria were monitored daily, and twice daily during the peak of lethality (days 6 through 12).

description: Monitoring parasitaemia daily by Giemsa-stained thin film blood smears and assessing significance using the Mann–Whitney U test.
span_chunk: Parasitaemia (percentage of parasite-infected erythrocytes) was monitored daily by Giemsa-stained thin film blood smears.

description: Assessing the significance of survival courses by comparing Kaplan-Meier curves using the log rank (Mantel-Cox) test.
span_chunk: The significance of survival courses was assessed by comparing Kaplan-Meier curves using the log rank (Mantel-Cox) test (α = 0.05).

description: Measuring all plasma cytokines by multiplexed cytometric bead immunoassay and detecting on a MAGPIX (Luminex).
span_chunk: All plasma cytokines were measured by multiplexed cytometric bead immunoassay (Millipore) as per manufacturer instructions and detected on a MAGPIX (Luminex).

description: Using a Mann–Whitney U test to assess the significance of cytokine levels.
span_chunk: Cytokine level significance was assessed using a Mann–Whitney U test (α = 0.05).
